// 예시 화면은 패턴을 보여 주기 위한 것이다. 각 메뉴의 도메인 규칙은 그 메뉴의 화면정의서가 명세한다.

/** 보기 단계 예시: 화면 관리 > 기본 설정(저장값 없음 → 기본값). */
function BasicSettingsView() {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="기본 설정">
      <PageHeader title="기본 설정" actions={<Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>} />
      <Card data-spec-id="pattern-view">
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="테마">라이트 모드</ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="배경 색상">#FFFFFF</ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="키 색상">#191919</ReadonlyField>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 수정 단계 예시: 화면 관리 > 기본 설정 수정. dialog는 수정 화면 위에 연 확인·알림이다. */
function BasicSettingsEdit({ saving, dialog }: { saving?: boolean; dialog?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="기본 설정">
      <PageHeader back title="기본 설정 수정" />
      <Card data-spec-id="pattern-edit">
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <FieldSet>
              <FieldLegend variant="label">
                테마 <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLegend>
              <RadioGroup defaultValue="light">
                <Field orientation="horizontal">
                  <RadioGroupItem value="light" id="pattern-theme-light" />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-theme-light" className="font-normal">
                    라이트 모드
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
                <Field orientation="horizontal">
                  <RadioGroupItem value="dark" id="pattern-theme-dark" />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-theme-dark" className="font-normal">
                    다크 모드
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
              </RadioGroup>
            </FieldSet>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-bg-color">
                배경 색상
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input id="pattern-bg-color" defaultValue="#FFFFFF" className="max-w-xs" />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-key-color">
                키 색상
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input id="pattern-key-color" defaultValue="#191919" className="max-w-xs" />
            </Field>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button disabled={saving} data-spec-id="page-save">
            {saving && <Spinner data-icon="inline-start" />}
            저장
          </Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
      {dialog}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 목록 예시: 관리 > 공개 > 이력(공개 이력 20건씩). loading이면 표 본문을 불러오는 중 표시로 바꾼다. */
function PublishHistoryList({ loading }: { loading?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="관리" sub="공개" third="이력">
      <PageHeader title="공개 이력" description="공개 이력을 조회합니다." />
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <PublishHistoryTable records={PUBLISH_HISTORY.slice(0, PUBLISH_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE)} loading={loading} />
          <ListPagination page={1} totalPages={Math.ceil(PUBLISH_HISTORY.length / PUBLISH_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE)} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 이미지 업로드 예시: 화면 관리 > 웹샵 로고 등록에서 5MB를 넘는 파일을 고른 직후. */
function LogoUploadError() {

                '지원 형식: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP (투명 배경 권장)',

              images={[]}
              max={1}
              error="최대 5MB까지 업로드 가능합니다."

          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline">취소</Button>
          <Button>저장</Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/credential/prd-credential.md @ 9206391d0803
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';

import { RequiredMark } from '../../shared/page';
import {
  IDP_INPUT_APPLE,
  IDP_INPUT_REGISTER_INVALID,
  IDP_KINDS,
  IDPS_REGISTER_BASE,
  type IdpInput,
  type IdpInputErrors,
  type IdpKind,
} from '../shared/mock';
import { IDP_FIELD_ERROR_SPECS, IDP_FIELD_SPECS, IdpFormFields } from './idp-form';
import { IdpListPage } from './idp-list-page';

/** 등록 대화상자의 배경 목록. Google·LINE만 등록되어 있다. */
const REGISTERED = IDPS_REGISTER_BASE;

/** Identity Provider 선택지: 아직 등록하지 않은 IdP만(CR 4.2). 첫 항목은 고르기 전 표시. */
const IDP_ITEMS: { label: string; value: IdpKind | null }[] = [
  { label: '선택', value: null },
  ...IDP_KINDS.filter((kind) => !REGISTERED.some((idp) => idp.kind === kind)).map((kind) => ({
    label: kind,
    value: kind,
  })),
];

/** IdP 등록 대화상자(CR 4.2). IdP 목록 위에 연다. kind = 고른 Identity Provider(null = 고르기 전). */
function IdpRegisterScreen({
  kind,
  values = {},
  errors,
}: {
  kind: IdpKind | null;
  values?: IdpInput;
  errors?: IdpInputErrors;
}) {
  return (
    <IdpListPage idps={REGISTERED}>
      <Dialog open>
        <DialogContent showCloseButton={false} className="sm:max-w-lg" data-spec-id="idp-dialog">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>인증 정보 등록</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-spec-id="field-idp">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="idp-kind">
                Identity Provider
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Select items={IDP_ITEMS} value={kind}>
                <SelectTrigger id="idp-kind" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectGroup>
                    {IDP_ITEMS.map((item) => (
                      <SelectItem key={item.label} value={item.value}>
                        {item.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectGroup>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <IdpFormFields kind={kind} values={values} errors={errors} />
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="dialog-cancel">
              취소
            </Button>
            <Button data-spec-id="dialog-submit">등록</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </IdpListPage>
  );
}

  title: '인증 정보/1. 인증 설정/등록',
} satisfies Meta;

export default meta;

};

import { PRODUCT_LIST, type Category } from '../shared/mock';
import { CategoryListPage } from './category-list';

type CategoryFormValues = { name: string; description: string; use: boolean; color: CategoryColor };

/** 등록 기본값: 이름·설명 없음, 사용, PURPLE(PD 9.2). */
const CREATE_DEFAULTS: CategoryFormValues = { name: '', description: '', use: true, color: 'PURPLE' };

/** 수정 대상 '데일리 상품'(C2). 등록 — 입력 오류 스토리는 같은 이름을 입력해 중복이 된다. */
const DAILY = PRODUCT_LIST.categories.find((category) => category.id === 'C2') as Category;

/** 51자 설명(50자 초과). */
const TOO_LONG_DESCRIPTION = '매일 오전 5시에 갱신되는 상품을 모아 둔 카테고리입니다. 하루 한 번씩 꼭 확인해 주세요.';

/**
 * 카테고리 등록·수정 대화상자(PD 9.2, PD 9.3). 가정: PRD에 화면 형태가 없어 카테고리 목록 위 대화상자로 연다.
 * errors는 [등록]·[수정]을 누른 직후의 검증 결과다(PD 9.6).
 */
function CategoryFormDialog({
  mode,
  values,
  errors = {},
}: {
  mode: 'create' | 'edit';
  values: CategoryFormValues;
  errors?: { name?: string; description?: string };
}) {
  const action = mode === 'create' ? '등록' : '수정';

  return (
    <Dialog open>
      <DialogContent showCloseButton={false} className="sm:max-w-xl" data-spec-id="category-dialog">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>카테고리 {action}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <FieldGroup>
          <Field data-invalid={!!errors.name || undefined} data-spec-id="field-name">
            <FieldLabel htmlFor="category-form-name">
              카테고리
              <RequiredMark />
            </FieldLabel>
            <Input id="category-form-name" defaultValue={values.name} aria-invalid={!!errors.name || undefined} />
            {errors.name && <FieldError>{errors.name}</FieldError>}
          </Field>
          <Field data-invalid={!!errors.description || undefined} data-spec-id="field-description">
            <FieldLabel htmlFor="category-form-description">설명</FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id="category-form-description"
              defaultValue={values.description}
              aria-invalid={!!errors.description || undefined}
            />
            {errors.description && <FieldError>{errors.description}</FieldError>}
          </Field>
          <FieldSet data-spec-id="field-use">
            <FieldLegend variant="label">
              카테고리 사용 여부 <RequiredMark />
            </FieldLegend>
            <RadioGroup defaultValue={values.use ? 'used' : 'unused'}>
              <Field orientation="horizontal">
                <RadioGroupItem value="used" id="category-form-use-used" />
                <FieldLabel htmlFor="category-form-use-used" className="font-normal">
                  사용
                </FieldLabel>
              </Field>
              <Field orientation="horizontal">
                <RadioGroupItem value="unused" id="category-form-use-unused" />
                <FieldLabel htmlFor="category-form-use-unused" className="font-normal">
                  미사용
                </FieldLabel>
              </Field>
            </RadioGroup>
          </FieldSet>
          <FieldSet data-spec-id="field-color">
            <FieldLegend variant="label">
              상품 배경색 <RequiredMark />
            </FieldLegend>
            <FieldDescription>선택한 배경 컬러는 투명도 10%대로 적용됩니다.</FieldDescription>
            <RadioGroup defaultValue={values.color} className="grid-cols-4">
              {CATEGORY_COLORS.map((color) => (
                <Field key={color} orientation="horizontal">
                  <RadioGroupItem value={color} id={`category-form-color-${color}`} />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`category-form-color-${color}`} className="font-normal">
                    <CategoryColorChip color={color} withName />
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
              ))}
            </RadioGroup>
          </FieldSet>
        </FieldGroup>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="dialog-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button data-spec-id="dialog-submit">{action}</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/** 목록 위에 대화상자를 연 화면. */
function CategoryFormScreen(props: Parameters<typeof CategoryFormDialog>[0]) {
  return <CategoryListPage categories={PRODUCT_LIST.categories} dialog={<CategoryFormDialog {...props} />} />;
}

import type { RichContentBlock } from '@/wireframes/shared/rich-content';

import { MaintenancePreviewDialog } from './maintenance-preview-dialog';

type ScreenType = 'default' | 'url';

/** 등록·수정 입력값. 일시는 입력 칸 그대로 날짜(yyyy-mm-dd)와 시각(HH:mm) 문자열로 둔다. */
type MaintenanceFormValues = {
  startDate: string;
  startTime: string;
  endDate: string;
  endTime: string;
  immediate: boolean;
  showEndTime: boolean;
  screenType: ScreenType;
  /** 서식 편집기 내용. 입력 영역에는 서식을 뺀 글자로, 미리보기에는 서식 그대로 보인다. */
  content: RichContentBlock[];
  url: string;
  reason: string;
};

/** 등록 기본값(OP 5.2): 모두 빈 값, 즉시 점검·종료 예정 시각 표시 선택 안 함, 기본 점검 화면. */
const EMPTY_VALUES: MaintenanceFormValues = {
  startDate: '',
  startTime: '',
  endDate: '',
  endTime: '',
  immediate: false,
  showEndTime: false,
  screenType: 'default',
  content: [],
  url: '',
  reason: '',
};

/** 수정은 저장된 값에서 시작한다(OP 5.6). 저장 전 입력 예시도 같은 방법으로 입력 칸 값으로 바꾼다. */
function toFormValues(maintenance: MaintenanceInput): MaintenanceFormValues {
  const [startDate, startTime] = formatDateTime(maintenance.startAt).split(' ');
  const [endDate, endTime] = formatDateTime(maintenance.endAt).split(' ');
  return {
    startDate,
    startTime,
    endDate,
    endTime,
    immediate: maintenance.immediate,
    showEndTime: maintenance.showEndTime,
    screenType: maintenance.screen.type,
    content: maintenance.screen.type === 'default' ? maintenance.screen.blocks : [],
    url: maintenance.screen.type === 'url' ? maintenance.screen.url : '',
    reason: maintenance.reason,
  };
}

/** 입력 영역에 보이는 글자(서식 제외). */
function toPlainText(blocks: RichContentBlock[]): string {
  return blocks
    .map((block) =>
      block.type === 'list'
        ? block.items.map((item, index) => (block.ordered ? `${index + 1}. ${item}` : `• ${item}`)).join('\n')
        : block.text,
    )
    .join('\n');
}

/** 입력 칸의 날짜·시각을 운영자 기기 시간대(UTC+9 가정)의 일시로 읽는다. */
function toDate(date: string, time: string): Date | undefined {
  return date && time ? new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+09:00`) : undefined;
}

              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectGroup>
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
      <ToggleGroup multiple variant="outline" size="sm" spacing={0} aria-label="목록">
        <ToggleGroupItem value="bullet" aria-label="글머리 기호 목록">
          <ListIcon />
        </ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="ordered" aria-label="번호 목록">
          <ListOrderedIcon />
        </ToggleGroupItem>
      </ToggleGroup>
      <ToggleGroup defaultValue={['left']} variant="outline" size="sm" spacing={0} aria-label="정렬">
        <ToggleGroupItem value="left" aria-label="왼쪽 정렬">
          <TextAlignStartIcon />
        </ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="center" aria-label="가운데 정렬">
          <TextAlignCenterIcon />
        </ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="right" aria-label="오른쪽 정렬">
          <TextAlignEndIcon />
        </ToggleGroupItem>
      </ToggleGroup>
      <Popover>
        <PopoverTrigger render={<Button variant="outline" size="icon-sm" aria-label="글자 색상" />}>
          <BaselineIcon />
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent align="start">
          <PopoverHeader>
            <PopoverTitle>글자 색상</PopoverTitle>
            <PopoverDescription>기본 색상 또는 사용자 지정 색상</PopoverDescription>
          </PopoverHeader>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
      <Button variant="outline" size="icon-sm" aria-label="링크">
        <LinkIcon />
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 운영 > 점검 > 목록 > 점검 등록·점검 수정(OP 5.1). 점검 기간 → 즉시 점검 → 점검 종료 예정 시각 표시 →
 * 점검 화면(유형 + 콘텐츠 또는 URL) → 점검 사유 → [취소] [점검 미리보기] [저장].
 * 즉시 점검과 점검 화면 유형은 고르는 대로 입력 칸이 바뀐다.
 */
function MaintenanceFormPage({
  mode,
  values,
  status = '예약',
  errors = {},
  preview,
}: {
  mode: 'create' | 'edit';
  values: MaintenanceFormValues;
  /** 수정하는 점검의 상태. 진행 중이면 시작 일시와 즉시 점검을 바꿀 수 없다(OP 5.6). */
  status?: MaintenanceStatus;
  /** [저장]을 누른 직후의 항목별 오류(OP 5.8). */
  errors?: { period?: string; content?: string; url?: string; reason?: string };
  /** 점검 미리보기 대화상자를 연 상태로 그린다. */
  preview?: boolean;
}) {
  const [immediate, setImmediate] = useState(values.immediate);
  const [screenType, setScreenType] = useState<ScreenType>(values.screenType);
  const started = mode === 'edit' && status === '진행 중';
  const startDisabled = immediate || started;
  const periodInvalid = errors.period ? true : undefined;

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="운영" sub="점검" third="목록">
      <PageHeader back title={mode === 'create' ? '점검 등록' : '점검 수정'} />
      <ImmediateApplyNotice />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-invalid={periodInvalid} data-spec-id="field-period">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-start-date">
                점검 기간
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <Input
                  id="maintenance-start-date"
                  type="date"
                  aria-label="시작 날짜"
                  className="w-40"
                  defaultValue={values.startDate}
                  disabled={startDisabled}
                  aria-invalid={periodInvalid}
                />
                <Input
                  type="time"
                  step={60}
                  aria-label="시작 시각"
                  className="w-32"
                  defaultValue={values.startTime}
                  disabled={startDisabled}
                  aria-invalid={periodInvalid}
                />
                <span>~</span>
                <Input
                  type="date"
                  aria-label="종료 날짜"
                  className="w-40"
                  defaultValue={values.endDate}
                  aria-invalid={periodInvalid}
                />
                <Input
                  type="time"
                  step={60}
                  aria-label="종료 시각"
                  className="w-32"
                  defaultValue={values.endTime}
                  aria-invalid={periodInvalid}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.period && <FieldError>{errors.period}</FieldError>}
            </Field>
            <Field orientation="horizontal" data-disabled={started || undefined} data-spec-id="field-immediate">
              <Checkbox
                id="maintenance-immediate"
                checked={immediate}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) => setImmediate(checked)}
                disabled={started}
              />
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-immediate" className="font-normal">
                즉시 점검
              </FieldLabel>
            </Field>
            <Field orientation="horizontal" data-spec-id="field-show-end">
              <Checkbox id="maintenance-show-end" defaultChecked={values.showEndTime} />
              <FieldContent>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-show-end" className="font-normal">
                  점검 종료 예정 시각 표시
                </FieldLabel>
                <FieldDescription>사용자가 점검이 언제 종료되는지 확인할 수 있습니다.</FieldDescription>
              </FieldContent>
            </Field>
            <FieldSet>
              <FieldLegend variant="label">
                점검 화면
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLegend>
              <RadioGroup
                value={screenType}
                onValueChange={(value) => setScreenType(value as ScreenType)}
                data-spec-id="field-screen-type"
              >
                <Field orientation="horizontal">
                  <RadioGroupItem value="default" id="maintenance-screen-default" />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-screen-default" className="font-normal">
                    기본 점검 화면
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
                <Field orientation="horizontal">
                  <RadioGroupItem value="url" id="maintenance-screen-url" />
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-screen-url" className="font-normal">
                    외부 점검 화면 (URL)
                  </FieldLabel>
                </Field>
              </RadioGroup>
              {screenType === 'default' ? (
                <Field data-invalid={errors.content ? true : undefined}>
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-content" className="sr-only">
                    점검 화면 콘텐츠
                  </FieldLabel>
                  <EditorToolbar />
                  <Textarea
                    id="maintenance-content"
                    placeholder="점검 안내 문구를 입력하세요."
                    className="min-h-40"
                    defaultValue={toPlainText(values.content)}
                    aria-invalid={errors.content ? true : undefined}
                    data-spec-id="field-content"
                  />
                  {errors.content && <FieldError>{errors.content}</FieldError>}
                </Field>
              ) : (
                <Field data-invalid={errors.url ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-url">
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-url" className="sr-only">
                    외부 점검 화면 URL
                  </FieldLabel>
                  <Input id="maintenance-url" defaultValue={values.url} aria-invalid={errors.url ? true : undefined} />
                  <FieldDescription>
                    사용하실 점검 페이지의 URL을 입력하세요. URL 뒤에 점검 정보(시간•메시지)를 파라메터로 함께
                    전달합니다.
                  </FieldDescription>
                  {errors.url && <FieldError>{errors.url}</FieldError>}
                </Field>
              )}
            </FieldSet>
            <Field data-invalid={errors.reason ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-reason">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="maintenance-reason">
                점검 사유
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Textarea
                id="maintenance-reason"
                defaultValue={values.reason}
                aria-invalid={errors.reason ? true : undefined}
              />
              {errors.reason && <FieldError>{errors.reason}</FieldError>}
            </Field>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="form-preview">
            <EyeIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
            점검 미리보기
          </Button>
          <Button data-spec-id="page-save">저장</Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
      {preview && (
        <MaintenancePreviewDialog
          blocks={values.content}
          startAt={values.immediate ? undefined : toDate(values.startDate, values.startTime)}
          endAt={toDate(values.endDate, values.endTime)}
          showEndTime={values.showEndTime}
        />
      )}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/product/prd-product.md @ eadb155ba5bc
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';

import { HistoryIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { CategoryColorChip } from '@/wireframes/shared/category-color';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { formatDateTime, formatPrice } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';

import { LIVE_PREVIEW, type LivePreview, type LivePreviewCategory } from '../shared/mock';
import { ProductStatusBadge, ProductThumb, formatSalePeriod, getPublishedStatus } from '../shared/product-display';
import { listPublishedProducts } from './published-product';

/** 공개 시점 카테고리 하나와 그 상품 표. annotate면 카드 머리와 첫 행에 명세 id를 붙인다. */
function PublishedCategoryCard({ category, annotate }: { category: LivePreviewCategory; annotate: boolean }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader {...(annotate ? { 'data-spec-id': 'live-category' } : {})}>
        <CardTitle>
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
            <CategoryColorChip color={category.color} />
            {category.name}
          </span>
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>이미지</TableHead>
              <TableHead>상품명(상품 ID)</TableHead>
              <TableHead>가격</TableHead>
              <TableHead>판매 기간</TableHead>
              <TableHead>상태</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {listPublishedProducts(category).map((product, index) => (
              <TableRow key={product.id} {...(annotate && index === 0 ? { 'data-spec-id': 'live-row' } : {})}>
                <TableCell>
                  <ProductThumb caption={product.imageCaption} color={category.color} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {product.name} ({product.id})
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatPrice(product.price, product.currency)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatSalePeriod(product.sale, 'minute')}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <ProductStatusBadge status={getPublishedStatus(product)} />
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** 상품 관리 > 상품 정보 > 라이브 프리뷰(PD 8.1). preview가 null이면 공개 이력이 없는 상태다. */
function LivePreviewPage({ preview }: { preview: LivePreview | null }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="상품 관리" sub="상품 정보" third="라이브 프리뷰">
      <PageHeader title="라이브 프리뷰" />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <ReadonlyField label="최신 공개 일자" specId="live-published-at">
            {preview ? formatDateTime(preview.publishedAt, 'second') : '-'}
          </ReadonlyField>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      {preview ? (
        preview.categories.map((category, index) => (
          <PublishedCategoryCard key={category.id} category={category} annotate={index === 0} />
        ))
      ) : (
        <Empty data-spec-id="live-empty">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <HistoryIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>공개 이력이 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
          </EmptyHeader>
        </Empty>
      )}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/operations/prd-operations.md @ 5f887ffe652e
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { EyeIcon, GlobeIcon, PlusIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { FieldGroup } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ImmediateApplyNotice, OPS_NOTICE_SPEC } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/immediate-apply-notice';
import { formatMaintenancePeriod } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/maintenance-display';
import { MultilineText } from '@/wireframes/shared/multiline-text';
import {
  MAINTENANCE_IN_PROGRESS,
  MAINTENANCES_RESERVED,
  PUBLISHED_STATE,
  UNPUBLISHED_STATE,
  type Maintenance,
  type PublishedState,
} from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/mock';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { formatDuration, MOCK_NOW } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { ListPagination } from '@/wireframes/shared/list-pagination';
import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';

/** 예약된 점검 목록의 페이지 크기(OP 4.3). */
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * 운영 > 점검 > 목록(OP 4.1). [점검 등록] → 반영 시점 안내 → WEBSHOP 운영 상태 → 예약된 점검 목록 순서.
 * 공개 전이면 운영 상태와 예약 목록 대신 공개 전 안내만 보여 준다.
 */
function MaintenanceListPage({
  publishState,
  inProgress,
  reserved,
  releaseConfirm,
}: {
  publishState: PublishedState;
  /** 진행 중 점검. 있으면 운영 상태가 "점검 중"이다(OP 3.4). */
  inProgress?: Maintenance;
  /** 시작 일시가 현재 이후인 점검(시작 오름차순). */
  reserved: Maintenance[];
  /** 점검 해제 확인을 연 상태로 그린다. */
  releaseConfirm?: boolean;
}) {
  const rows = reserved.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="운영" sub="점검" third="목록">
      <PageHeader
        title="점검"
        actions={
          <Button disabled={!publishState.published} data-spec-id="page-create">
            <PlusIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
            점검 등록
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <ImmediateApplyNotice />
      {publishState.published ? (
        <>
          <Card data-spec-id="ops-status">
            <CardHeader>
              <Badge variant={inProgress ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'} data-spec-id="ops-status-badge">
                {inProgress ? '점검 중' : '운영 중'}
              </Badge>
              <CardTitle>{inProgress ? '점검이 진행 중입니다.' : 'WEBSHOP이 정상 운영 중입니다.'}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                {inProgress
                  ? `점검 종료까지 약 ${formatDuration(inProgress.endAt.getTime() - MOCK_NOW.getTime())} 남았습니다.`
                  : reserved.length > 0
                    ? '현재 진행 중인 점검이 없습니다. 예약된 점검은 아래 목록에서 확인해 주세요.'
                    : '현재 진행 중이거나 예약된 점검이 없습니다.'}
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            {inProgress && (
              <>
                <CardContent>
                  <FieldGroup>
                    <ReadonlyField label="점검 기간" specId="ops-progress-period">
                      {formatMaintenancePeriod(inProgress)}
                    </ReadonlyField>
                    <ReadonlyField label="경과 / 종료시간" specId="ops-progress-elapsed">
                      {formatDuration(MOCK_NOW.getTime() - inProgress.startAt.getTime())} 경과 /{' '}
                      {formatDuration(inProgress.endAt.getTime() - MOCK_NOW.getTime())} 남음
                    </ReadonlyField>
                    <ReadonlyField label="점검 사유" specId="ops-progress-reason">
                      <MultilineText text={inProgress.reason} />
                    </ReadonlyField>
                  </FieldGroup>
                </CardContent>
                <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
                  <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="ops-detail">
                    점검 상세보기
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="ops-preview">
                    <EyeIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                    점검 미리보기
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="destructive" data-spec-id="ops-release">
                    점검 해제
                  </Button>
                </CardFooter>
              </>
            )}
          </Card>
          <Card data-spec-id="reserved-card">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>예약된 점검</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              {rows.length > 0 ? (
                <>
                  <Table data-spec-id="list-table">
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>점검 예약 기간</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>점검 사유</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {rows.map((maintenance, index) => (
                        <TableRow key={maintenance.id} {...(index === 0 ? { 'data-spec-id': 'list-row' } : {})}>
                          <TableCell>{formatMaintenancePeriod(maintenance)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{maintenance.reason}</TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                  <ListPagination page={1} totalPages={Math.ceil(reserved.length / PAGE_SIZE)} />
                </>
              ) : (
                <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
                  <EmptyHeader>
                    <EmptyTitle>예약된 점검이 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
                    <EmptyDescription>점검을 예약해두면 자동으로 시작·종료됩니다.</EmptyDescription>
                  </EmptyHeader>
                </Empty>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Empty data-spec-id="ops-unpublished">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <GlobeIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>웹샵이 공개되지 않았습니다.</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              공개 이후에 점검을 설정할 수 있습니다.
              <br />
              점검은 운영 중인 WEBSHOP을 일시 중단하는 기능이므로, 먼저 공개를 완료해 주세요.
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyContent>
            <Button data-spec-id="ops-move-publish">공개 메뉴로 이동</Button>
          </EmptyContent>
        </Empty>
      )}
      {releaseConfirm && (
        <NoticeDialog
          title="점검 해제"
          message={'점검을 해제하시겠습니까?\n해제 시 사용자가 WEBSHOP에 접속 가능합니다.'}
          cancelLabel="취소"
          destructive
        />
      )}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/credential/prd-credential.md @ 9206391d0803

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { EyeIcon, EyeOffIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { FieldGroup } from '@/components/ui/field';

import { NoticeDialog } from '../../shared/notice-dialog';
import { ReadonlyField } from '../../shared/page';
import { IDP_ID_LABELS, IDPS, type IdpSetting } from '../shared/mock';
import { IdpListPage } from './idp-list-page';

const GOOGLE = IDPS.find((idp) => idp.kind === 'Google')!;
const GUEST = IDPS.find((idp) => idp.kind === 'Guest')!;

/**
 * IdP 상세 대화상자(CR 4.3). IdP 목록 위에 연다. 모든 정보는 읽기 전용이다.
 * Guest는 ID 항목·Secret Key 대신 로그인 방법을 보여 준다. Secret Key는 secretShown일 때만 실제 값.
 * deleteConfirm이면 상세 위에 삭제 확인(CR 4.5)을 연다.
 */
function IdpDetailScreen({
  idp,
  secretShown,
  deleteConfirm,
}: {
  idp: IdpSetting;
  secretShown?: boolean;
  deleteConfirm?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <IdpListPage idps={IDPS}>
      <Dialog open>
        <DialogContent showCloseButton={false} className="sm:max-w-lg" data-spec-id="idp-dialog">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>인증 정보</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="Identity Provider" specId="view-idp">
              {idp.kind}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="인증 수단 표시명" specId="view-display-name">
              {idp.displayName ?? ''}
            </ReadonlyField>
            {idp.kind === 'Guest' ? (
              <ReadonlyField label="로그인 방법" specId="view-guest-methods">
                {idp.guestMethods?.join(', ')}
              </ReadonlyField>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ReadonlyField label={IDP_ID_LABELS[idp.kind]} specId="view-idp-id">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2 break-all">
                    {idp.idValue}
                    {idp.kind === 'LINE' && <Badge variant="secondary">JAPAN</Badge>}
                  </span>
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="Secret Key" specId="view-secret">
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                    <span className="break-all whitespace-pre-wrap">{secretShown ? idp.secret : '••••••••••••'}</span>
                    <Button variant="link" data-spec-id="secret-toggle">
                      {secretShown ? <EyeOffIcon data-icon="inline-start" /> : <EyeIcon data-icon="inline-start" />}
                      {secretShown ? '비밀키 숨기기' : '비밀키 보기'}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </ReadonlyField>
              </>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter className="sm:justify-between">
            <Button variant="destructive" data-spec-id="page-delete">
              삭제
            </Button>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="dialog-cancel">
                취소
              </Button>
              <Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>
            </div>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
      {deleteConfirm && (
        <NoticeDialog title="인증 정보 삭제" message="인증 정보를 삭제하시겠습니까?" cancelLabel="취소" destructive />
      )}
    </IdpListPage>
  );
}

};

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/operations/prd-operations.md @ 5f887ffe652e
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { EyeIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { FieldGroup } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { ImmediateApplyNotice, OPS_NOTICE_SPEC } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/immediate-apply-notice';
import { formatMaintenancePeriod, getMaintenanceStatus } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/maintenance-display';
import { MultilineText } from '@/wireframes/shared/multiline-text';
import { MAINTENANCE_IN_PROGRESS, MAINTENANCES_RESERVED, type Maintenance } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/mock';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';
import { RichContent } from '@/wireframes/shared/rich-content';

/**
 * 운영 > 점검 > 목록 > 점검 상세 정보(OP 6.1). 등록과 같은 항목을 읽기 전용으로 보여 준다.
 * [삭제]는 예약 상태일 때만 있다.
 */
function MaintenanceDetailPage({ maintenance, deleteConfirm }: { maintenance: Maintenance; deleteConfirm?: boolean }) {
  const status = getMaintenanceStatus(maintenance);

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="운영" sub="점검" third="목록">
      <PageHeader
        back
        title="점검 상세 정보"
        badge={
          <Badge variant={status === '진행 중' ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'} data-spec-id="detail-status">
            {status}
          </Badge>
        }
      />
      <ImmediateApplyNotice />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 기간" specId="view-period">
              {formatMaintenancePeriod(maintenance)}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="즉시 점검" specId="view-immediate">
              {maintenance.immediate ? 'Y' : 'N'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 종료 예정 시각 표시" specId="view-show-end">
              {maintenance.showEndTime ? 'Y' : 'N'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 화면" specId="view-screen-type">
              {maintenance.screen.type === 'default' ? '기본 점검 화면' : '외부 점검 화면 (URL)'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            {maintenance.screen.type === 'default' ? (
              <ReadonlyField label="점검 화면 콘텐츠" specId="view-content">
                <RichContent blocks={maintenance.screen.blocks} />
              </ReadonlyField>
            ) : (
              <ReadonlyField label="외부 점검 화면 URL" specId="view-url">
                {maintenance.screen.url}
              </ReadonlyField>
            )}
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 사유" specId="view-reason">
              <MultilineText text={maintenance.reason} />
            </ReadonlyField>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-list">
              목록
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="detail-preview">
              <EyeIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
              점검 미리보기
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {status === '예약' && (
              <Button variant="destructive" data-spec-id="page-delete">
                삭제
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
      {deleteConfirm && (
        <NoticeDialog title="점검 삭제" message="예약 점검을 삭제하시겠습니까?" cancelLabel="취소" destructive />
      )}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

} satisfies Meta;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

const VIEW_SHOW_END: SpecAnnotation = {
  id: 'view-show-end',

/**

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { PRODUCT_LIST, PRODUCT_SAMPLES, type Product } from '../shared/mock';
import { ProductDetailPage } from './product-detail';

function findProduct(id: string): Product {
  const product = PRODUCT_LIST.products.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!product) throw new Error(`unknown product ${id}`);
  return product;
}

/** 수정 — 입력 오류: P-1007을 바탕으로 이미지·판매 기간·안내 문구·제한 수량·주간 요일을 잘못 입력한 상태. */
const weekly = findProduct(PRODUCT_SAMPLES.weekly);
const INVALID_WEEKLY: Product = {
  ...weekly,
  imageCaption: undefined,
  sale: { start: new Date('2026-12-31T23:59:59+09:00'), end: new Date('2026-10-01T00:00:00+09:00') },
  notice: '',
  limit: { use: true, cycle: '주간', quantity: 150, time: '00:00:00' },
};

const meta = {
  title: '상품 관리/1. 상품 정보/상품 상세',
} satisfies Meta;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/dialog';

import { ReadonlyField } from '../../shared/page';
import { IDP_INPUT_EDIT_INVALID, IDPS, type IdpInput, type IdpInputErrors, type IdpSetting } from '../shared/mock';
import { IDP_FIELD_ERROR_SPECS, IDP_FIELD_SPECS, IdpFormFields } from './idp-form';
import { IdpListPage } from './idp-list-page';

const GOOGLE = IDPS.find((idp) => idp.kind === 'Google')!;

/**
 * IdP 수정 대화상자(CR 4.4). 상세에서 [수정]을 누르면 상세 대신 IdP 목록 위에 연다.
 * Identity Provider는 바꿀 수 없고, Secret Key는 가리지 않는다. values를 주지 않으면 저장값.
 */
function IdpEditScreen({ idp, values, errors }: { idp: IdpSetting; values?: IdpInput; errors?: IdpInputErrors }) {
  return (
    <IdpListPage idps={IDPS}>
      <Dialog open>
        <DialogContent showCloseButton={false} className="sm:max-w-lg" data-spec-id="idp-dialog">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>인증 정보 수정</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="Identity Provider" specId="field-idp">
              {idp.kind}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <IdpFormFields kind={idp.kind} values={values ?? idp} errors={errors} />
          </FieldGroup>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="dialog-cancel">
              취소
            </Button>
            <Button data-spec-id="dialog-submit">저장</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </IdpListPage>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/credential/prd-credential.md @ 9206391d0803
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { PlusIcon, Trash2Icon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSet,
  FieldTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group';

import { ConsoleShell } from '../../shared/console-shell';
import { PageHeader, RequiredMark } from '../../shared/page';
import {
  SERVER_API_DEFAULTS,
  SERVER_API_GUEST,
  SERVER_API_INPUT_INVALID,
  SERVER_API_RESERVED_MISSING,
  SERVER_API_TITLES,
  type ServerApi,
  type ServerApiErrors,
  type ServerApiKind,
} from '../shared/mock';

/** HTTP Header 최대 행 수(CR 5.2). */
const MAX_HEADERS = 5;

/** 인증 유형별 입력 안내 문구(CR 5.2). */
const HINTS: Record<ServerApiKind, { url: string; body: string }> = {
  social: {
    url: '초기 설정 시 필수 파라메터 providerId={providerId}&providerCode={providerCode}가 포함되어 전달되며, 이후 key 값은 변경 할 수 있으나 value 값은 고정되어 변경이 불가합니다.',
    body: 'providerId, providerCode 파라메터는 필수이며, key 값은 변경 할 수 있으나 value 값은 고정되어 변경이 불가합니다.',
  },
  guest: {
    url: '[인증 정보] - [인증 설정]에서 선택한 Guest 로그인 방법에 해당하는 파라미터만 포함하면 됩니다. {uid}, {guestCode} 중 하나 이상을 ? 뒤 쿼리에 포함하세요. # 뒤에 입력한 값은 게임 서버로 전달되지 않습니다. key 값은 변경할 수 있으나 value 값은 고정되어 변경할 수 없습니다.',
    body: '[인증 정보] - [인증 설정]에서 선택한 Guest 로그인 방법에 해당하는 파라미터만 포함하면 됩니다. {uid}, {guestCode} 중 하나 이상을 포함하세요. key 값은 변경할 수 있으나 value 값은 고정되어 변경할 수 없습니다.',
  },
};

/**
 * 서버 API 설정 등록·수정 화면(CR 5.2). 제목은 등록·수정 모두 "{인증 유형 표시 이름} 수정".
 * Request Method → URL(GET이면 안내) → Body(POST일 때만, 안내) → HTTP Header 행 + [행 추가] → [취소] [저장].
 */
function ServerApiEditPage({
  kind,
  api,
  errors = {},
}: {
  kind: ServerApiKind;
  api: ServerApi;
  errors?: ServerApiErrors;
}) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="인증 정보" sub="서버 API 설정">
      <PageHeader back title={`${SERVER_API_TITLES[kind]} 수정`} />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field data-spec-id="field-method">
              <FieldTitle id="server-api-method-label">
                Request Method
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldTitle>
              <ToggleGroup variant="outline" value={[api.method]} aria-labelledby="server-api-method-label">
                <ToggleGroupItem value="GET">GET</ToggleGroupItem>
                <ToggleGroupItem value="POST">POST</ToggleGroupItem>
              </ToggleGroup>
            </Field>
            <Field data-invalid={errors.url ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-url">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="server-api-url">
                URL
                <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id="server-api-url"
                placeholder="https://example.com"
                defaultValue={api.url}
                aria-invalid={errors.url ? true : undefined}
              />
              {api.method === 'GET' && <FieldDescription>{HINTS[kind].url}</FieldDescription>}
              {errors.url && <FieldError>{errors.url}</FieldError>}
            </Field>
            {api.method === 'POST' && (
              <Field data-invalid={errors.body ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-body">
                <FieldLabel htmlFor="server-api-body">
                  Body
                  <RequiredMark />
                </FieldLabel>
                <Textarea id="server-api-body" defaultValue={api.body} aria-invalid={errors.body ? true : undefined} />
                <FieldDescription>{HINTS[kind].body}</FieldDescription>
                {errors.body && <FieldError>{errors.body}</FieldError>}
              </Field>
            )}
            <FieldSet>
              <FieldLegend variant="label">HTTP Header</FieldLegend>
              {api.headers.length > 0 && (
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Key</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Value</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>
                        <span className="sr-only">삭제</span>
                      </TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {api.headers.map((header, index) => {
                      const rowError = errors.headers?.[index];
                      return (
                        <TableRow key={index} {...(index === 0 ? { 'data-spec-id': 'field-header-row' } : {})}>
                          <TableCell className="align-top">
                            <Field data-invalid={rowError?.key ? true : undefined}>
                              <Input
                                aria-label="Key"
                                placeholder="Key"
                                defaultValue={header.key}
                                aria-invalid={rowError?.key ? true : undefined}
                              />
                              {rowError?.key && <FieldError>{rowError.key}</FieldError>}
                            </Field>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="align-top">
                            <Field data-invalid={rowError?.value ? true : undefined}>
                              <Input
                                aria-label="Value"
                                placeholder="Value"
                                defaultValue={header.value}
                                aria-invalid={rowError?.value ? true : undefined}
                              />
                              {rowError?.value && <FieldError>{rowError.value}</FieldError>}
                            </Field>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="align-top">
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="행 삭제">
                              <Trash2Icon />
                            </Button>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              )}
              <div>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={api.headers.length >= MAX_HEADERS}
                  data-spec-id="field-header-add"
                >
                  <PlusIcon data-icon="inline-start" />행 추가
                </Button>
              </div>
            </FieldSet>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button data-spec-id="page-save">저장</Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '인증 정보/2. 서버 API 설정/수정',
} satisfies Meta;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

// ── 명세 조각 ──

const pageBack = (kind: ServerApiKind): SpecAnnotation => ({
  id: 'page-back',
  label: '뒤로 가기',
  state: `제목은 등록·수정 모두 "${SERVER_API_TITLES[kind]} 수정"이다(CR 5.2).`,

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/settings/prd-settings.md @ 66a528540925
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import { SearchIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldTitle } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { PUBLISH_HISTORY, type PublishRecord } from '@/wireframes/settings/shared/mock';
import { PUBLISH_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE, PublishHistoryTable } from '@/wireframes/settings/shared/publish-history-table';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { DateRangePicker } from '@/wireframes/shared/date-range-picker';
import { MOCK_NOW } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { ListPagination } from '@/wireframes/shared/list-pagination';
import { PageHeader } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';

/** 페이지당 건수(ST 6.2). */

type StatusFilter = '전체' | '성공' | '실패';

/** 상태 검색 조건(ST 6.1). */
const STATUS_ITEMS: { label: string; value: StatusFilter }[] = [
  { label: '전체', value: '전체' },
  { label: '성공', value: '성공' },
  { label: '실패', value: '실패' },
];

/** 운영자 현지 시각(UTC+9) 기준 날짜. */
const day = (date: string) => new Date(`${date}T00:00:00+09:00`);

/**
 * 관리 > 공개 > 이력(ST 6). from·to·status는 마지막으로 [검색]한 조건, records는 그 결과(최신순)다.
 * 결과의 첫 페이지를 보여 준다.
 */
function PublishHistoryPage({
  from,
  to,
  status,
  records,
}: {
  from: Date;
  to: Date;
  status: StatusFilter;
  records: PublishRecord[];
}) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="관리" sub="공개" third="이력">
      <PageHeader title="공개 이력" description="공개 이력을 조회합니다." />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup className="flex-row flex-wrap items-center">
            <Field orientation="horizontal" className="w-auto">
              <FieldTitle>날짜</FieldTitle>
              <DateRangePicker from={from} to={to} placeholder="날짜 선택" />
            </Field>
            <Field orientation="horizontal" className="w-auto">
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="publish-history-status">상태</FieldLabel>
              <Select items={STATUS_ITEMS} defaultValue={status}>
                <SelectTrigger id="publish-history-status" data-spec-id="search-status">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectGroup>
                    {STATUS_ITEMS.map((item) => (
                      <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                        {item.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectGroup>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Button data-spec-id="search-submit">
              <SearchIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
              검색
            </Button>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {records.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyTitle>조회된 결과가 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <>
              <PublishHistoryTable records={records.slice(0, PUBLISH_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE)} />
              <ListPagination page={1} totalPages={Math.ceil(records.length / PUBLISH_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE)} />
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/credential/prd-credential.md @ 9206391d0803
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { FieldGroup } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';

import { ConsoleShell } from '../../shared/console-shell';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField } from '../../shared/page';
import {
  SERVER_API_GUEST,
  SERVER_API_SOCIAL,
  SERVER_API_TITLES,
  type ServerApi,
  type ServerApiKind,
} from '../shared/mock';

const KINDS: ServerApiKind[] = ['social', 'guest'];

/** 미등록 안내(CR 5.1). 게스트에만 보조 안내가 있다. */
const UNREGISTERED_GUIDE: Record<ServerApiKind, string[]> = {
  social: ['소셜 (IdP) 로그인 인가 API를 설정하세요.'],
  guest: [
    'Guest 로그인 검증 API를 설정하세요.',
    '[인증 정보] - [인증 설정]에서 Guest 로그인을 지원하는 경우 필수로 설정해야합니다.',
  ],
};

/**
 * 인증 유형 하나의 서버 API 설정 카드(CR 5.1). 미등록이면 안내 + [등록], 등록이면 저장한 설정 + [수정].
 * 두 카드가 같은 항목을 가지므로 읽기 전용 항목의 spec id는 annotate가 가리킨 카드에만 붙인다.
 */
function ServerApiCard({
  kind,
  api,
  annotate,
}: {
  kind: ServerApiKind;
  api: ServerApi | null;
  annotate: { fields: boolean; body: boolean };
}) {
  return (
    <Card data-spec-id={`${kind}-api-card`}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{SERVER_API_TITLES[kind]}</CardTitle>
        {api && (
          <CardAction>
            <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id={`${kind}-api-edit`}>
              수정
            </Button>
          </CardAction>
        )}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {api ? (
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="Request Method" specId={annotate.fields ? 'view-method' : undefined}>
              <Badge variant="outline">{api.method}</Badge>
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="URL" specId={annotate.fields ? 'view-url' : undefined}>
              <span className="break-all">{api.url}</span>
            </ReadonlyField>
            {api.method === 'POST' && (
              <ReadonlyField label="Body" specId={annotate.body ? 'view-body' : undefined}>
                <Textarea readOnly defaultValue={api.body} aria-label="Body" />
              </ReadonlyField>
            )}
            {api.headers.length > 0 && (
              <ReadonlyField label="HTTP Header" specId={annotate.fields ? 'view-headers' : undefined}>
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>Key</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Value</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {api.headers.map((header, index) => (
                      <TableRow key={index}>
                        <TableCell>{header.key}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{header.value}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </ReadonlyField>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        ) : (
          <Empty>
            <EmptyHeader>
              {UNREGISTERED_GUIDE[kind].map((line) => (
                <EmptyDescription key={line}>{line}</EmptyDescription>
              ))}
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Button data-spec-id={`${kind}-api-register`}>등록</Button>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** 인증 정보 > 서버 API 설정 조회(CR 5.1). 인증 유형마다 카드 하나(소셜 → 게스트). */
function ServerApiViewPage({ apis }: { apis: Record<ServerApiKind, ServerApi | null> }) {
  const fieldsOwner = KINDS.find((kind) => apis[kind]);
  const bodyOwner = KINDS.find((kind) => apis[kind]?.method === 'POST');

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="인증 정보" sub="서버 API 설정">
      <PageHeader title="서버 API 설정" />
      {KINDS.map((kind) => (
        <ServerApiCard
          key={kind}
          kind={kind}
          api={apis[kind]}
          annotate={{ fields: kind === fieldsOwner, body: kind === bodyOwner }}
        />
      ))}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

} satisfies Meta;

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';

import { APP_SERVICES } from './console-mock';
import { ConsoleShell } from './console-shell';
import { formatPrice } from './format';
import { PageHeader } from './page';

/** 셸 안에 넣는 대표 본문(상품 관리 > 상품 정보 > 사용 카테고리). 상품 규칙은 상품 관리 화면정의서가 명세한다. */
const SAMPLE_PRODUCTS = [
  { id: 'P-1001', name: '다이아몬드 100개', price: formatPrice(1200, 'JPY'), status: 'On Sale' },
  { id: 'P-1002', name: '스타터 패키지', price: formatPrice(3000, 'JPY'), status: 'On Sale' },
  { id: 'P-1003', name: '연말 한정 패키지', price: formatPrice(5000, 'JPY'), status: 'Reserved' },
];

function SampleBody() {
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="사용 카테고리" />
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>추천 상품</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>상품명(상품 ID)</TableHead>
                <TableHead>가격</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Webshop 상태</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {SAMPLE_PRODUCTS.map((product) => (
                <TableRow key={product.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    {product.name} ({product.id})
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{product.price}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Badge variant={product.status === 'On Sale' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>{product.status}</Badge>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

  );
}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/storefront/prd-storefront.md @ a770a3c9a6c4
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemTitle } from '@/components/ui/item';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { formatPrice } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { StoreHomeBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-home';
import { STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN, STORE_USER } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';

import { STORE_AGE_BIRTHDATE, STORE_AGE_SELECT, type StoreAgeSegment, type StoreAgeSetting } from '../shared/mock';

/** 구간 라벨. 비어 있으면 "{n}구간"(SF 8.2) */
function segmentLabel(segment: StoreAgeSegment, index: number) {
  return segment.label || `${index + 1}구간`;
}

/** 월 결제 한도 금액. 円 고정(SF 8.2), 무제한이면 "제한 없음" */
function monthlyLimitText(segment: StoreAgeSegment) {
  return segment.monthlyLimit === null ? '제한 없음' : formatPrice(segment.monthlyLimit, 'JPY');
}

/** 구간별 결제 한도 표기. 한도 기간 "1개월" + 금액, 무제한이면 "제한 없음"만(SF 8.2, 8.3) */
function segmentLimitText(segment: StoreAgeSegment) {
  return segment.monthlyLimit === null ? '제한 없음' : `1개월 ${monthlyLimitText(segment)}`;
}

/**
 * 구매를 시작한 화면(홈, 로그인) 위의 연령 확인(SF 8). 형태는 대화상자(가정).
 * - 생년월일 입력: 생년월일 입력 + 구간별 결제 한도 목록 + [취소][확인]
 * - 연령 구분 선택: 구간 선택(확인 버튼 없이 고르면 진행, 가정)
 * - guideSegmentIndex: 구간 안내를 연 구간(0부터). 있으면 연령 확인 대신 그 구간의 구간 안내를 띄운다
 */
function AgeCheckScreen({
  setting,
  birthValue,
  birthError,
  guideSegmentIndex,
}: {
  setting: StoreAgeSetting;
  birthValue?: string;
  birthError?: string;
  guideSegmentIndex?: number;
}) {
  const birthdate = setting.type === '생년월일 입력';
  const guideSegment = guideSegmentIndex === undefined ? undefined : setting.segments[guideSegmentIndex];

  return (
    <StoreShell user={STORE_USER}>
      <StoreHomeBody categories={STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN} />

      {guideSegment?.guide ? (
        <Dialog open>
          <DialogContent data-spec-id="age-guide-dialog">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{guideSegment.guide.title}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="whitespace-pre-line">{guideSegment.guide.text}</DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <Item variant="muted" data-spec-id="age-guide-amount">
              <ItemContent>
                <ItemDescription>이번 달 구매 가능 금액</ItemDescription>
              </ItemContent>
              <ItemContent>
                <ItemTitle>{monthlyLimitText(guideSegment)}</ItemTitle>
              </ItemContent>
            </Item>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="age-guide-no">
                아니요
              </Button>
              <Button data-spec-id="age-guide-yes">예</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      ) : (
        <Dialog open>
          <DialogContent data-spec-id="age-dialog" showCloseButton={!birthdate}>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle data-spec-id="age-title">{setting.title || '생년월일 등록'}</DialogTitle>
              {setting.topNotice && (
                <DialogDescription className="whitespace-pre-line" data-spec-id="age-top">
                  {setting.topNotice}
                </DialogDescription>
              )}
            </DialogHeader>
            <FieldGroup>
              {birthdate ? (
                <>
                  <Field data-spec-id="age-birth" data-invalid={!!birthError}>
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="store-age-birth">생년월일</FieldLabel>
                    <Input
                      id="store-age-birth"
                      inputMode="numeric"
                      placeholder="(기재 예) 19980101"
                      defaultValue={birthValue}
                      aria-invalid={!!birthError}
                    />
                    {birthError && <FieldError>{birthError}</FieldError>}
                  </Field>
                  <ItemGroup data-spec-id="age-limits">
                    {setting.segments.map((segment, index) => (
                      <Item key={index} variant="outline" size="sm">
                        <ItemContent>
                          <ItemTitle>{segmentLabel(segment, index)}</ItemTitle>
                        </ItemContent>
                        <ItemContent>
                          <ItemDescription>{segmentLimitText(segment)}</ItemDescription>
                        </ItemContent>
                      </Item>
                    ))}
                  </ItemGroup>
                </>
              ) : (
                <RadioGroup aria-label="연령 구간" data-spec-id="age-segments">
                  {setting.segments.map((segment, index) => (
                    <FieldLabel
                      key={index}
                      htmlFor={`store-age-segment-${index}`}
                      {...(index === 0 ? { 'data-spec-id': 'age-segment' } : {})}
                    >
                      <Field orientation="horizontal">
                        <FieldContent>
                          <FieldTitle>{segmentLabel(segment, index)}</FieldTitle>
                          <FieldDescription>{segmentLimitText(segment)}</FieldDescription>
                        </FieldContent>
                        <RadioGroupItem value={String(index)} id={`store-age-segment-${index}`} />
                      </Field>
                    </FieldLabel>
                  ))}
                </RadioGroup>
              )}
              {setting.bottomNotice && (
                <FieldDescription className="whitespace-pre-line" data-spec-id="age-bottom">
                  {setting.bottomNotice}
                </FieldDescription>
              )}
            </FieldGroup>
            {birthdate && (
              <DialogFooter>
                <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="age-cancel">
                  취소
                </Button>
                <Button data-spec-id="age-ok">확인</Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            )}
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      )}
    </StoreShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '스토어프론트/5. 연령 확인',
  component: AgeCheckScreen,
} satisfies Meta<typeof AgeCheckScreen>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
