/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/screen/prd-screen.md @ e43175fbfc16
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import { Fragment } from 'react';

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { PlusIcon, Trash2Icon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
} from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput } from '@/components/ui/input-group';
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/radio-group';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';

import { ConsoleShell } from '../../shared/console-shell';
import { formatPrice } from '../../shared/format';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField, RequiredMark } from '../../shared/page';
import { pageBackSpec, pageCancelSpec, pageSaveSpec, publishTimingSpec } from '../shared/menu-spec';
import {
  AGE_BIRTHDATE,
  AGE_INVALID_INPUT,
  AGE_NO_GUIDE,
  AGE_SELECT,
  AGE_UNUSED,
  toAgeInput,
  type AgeInput,
  type AgeNotice,
  type AgeSegmentInput,
} from '../shared/mock';
import { first } from '../shared/spec-id';
import { UsageField } from '../shared/usage-field';
import { AgePreview } from './age-preview';

type SegmentErrors = { age?: string; limit?: string; guideTitle?: string; guideText?: string };

/** [저장]을 누른 직후의 필드 오류(SC 6.6). segments의 키는 구분 순서(0부터). */
type AgeErrors = { title?: string; segments?: Record<number, SegmentErrors> };

type Option = { value: string; description: string };

/** 선택지별 설명(SC 6.3). */
const TIMING_OPTIONS: Option[] = [
  {
    value: '로그인 후 1회',
    description: '로그인 후 최초 연령 확인을 완료하면, 다음 로그인 전까지는 연령 확인 팝업을 표시하지 않습니다.',
  },
  { value: '구매 시마다', description: '아이템 구매 버튼을 클릭할 때마다 연령 확인 팝업을 표시합니다.' },
];

const TYPE_OPTIONS: Option[] = [
  { value: '연령 구분 선택', description: '사용자가 정해진 연령 구분 중 하나를 선택하는 타입입니다.' },
  { value: '생년월일 입력', description: '사용자가 생년월일을 직접 입력하는 타입입니다.' },
];

/** 나이 입력 안내 문구(SC 6.3). 구분 순서대로. */
const AGE_PLACEHOLDERS = ['例) 16歳未満', '例) 16~19歳', '例) 20歳以上'];

const MAX_SEGMENTS = 3;

/** 선택지마다 설명이 붙는 라디오 선택 항목(연령 확인 표시 시점, 타입, SC 6.3). */
function ChoiceField({
  id,
  legend,
  value,
  options,
  specId,
}: {
  id: string;
  legend: string;
  value: string;
  options: Option[];
  specId: string;
}) {
  return (
    <FieldSet data-spec-id={specId}>
      <FieldLegend variant="label">
        {legend} <RequiredMark />
      </FieldLegend>
      <RadioGroup defaultValue={value}>
        {options.map((option, index) => (
          <Field key={option.value} orientation="horizontal">
            <RadioGroupItem value={option.value} id={`${id}-${index}`} />
            <FieldContent>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${index}`} className="font-normal">
                {option.value}
              </FieldLabel>
              <FieldDescription>{option.description}</FieldDescription>
            </FieldContent>
          </Field>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}

/** 상단·하단 안내 문구: 사용·미사용 + 사용이면 여러 줄 텍스트(SC 6.3). */
function NoticeField({
  id,
  legend,
  description,
  notice,
  specId,
}: {
  id: string;
  legend: string;
  description: string;
  notice: AgeNotice;
  specId: string;
}) {
  return (
    <UsageField id={`${id}-use`} legend={legend} description={description} defaultUse={notice.use} specId={specId}>
      {notice.use && (
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-text`} className="sr-only">
            {legend} 내용
          </FieldLabel>
          <Textarea id={`${id}-text`} defaultValue={notice.text} />
        </Field>
      )}
    </UsageField>
  );
}

/** 이번 달 구매 가능 금액(표시 전용, SC 6.3): 월 결제 한도 + 円, 제한 없음이면 "제한 없음". */
function availableAmount(segment: AgeSegmentInput) {
  if (segment.unlimited) return '제한 없음';
  if (!segment.limit.trim()) return '-円';
  return /^\d+$/.test(segment.limit) ? formatPrice(Number(segment.limit), 'JPY') : `${segment.limit}円`;
}

/** 구분 하나(구분{n}). 구간 안내를 사용할 때만 구간 안내 제목·문구와 이번 달 구매 가능 금액을 보여 준다. */
function SegmentFields({
  segment,
  index,
  errors = {},
}: {
  segment: AgeSegmentInput;
  index: number;
  errors?: SegmentErrors;
}) {
  const no = index + 1;
  const id = `age-segment-${no}`;

  return (
    <FieldSet {...first(index, 'field-segment')}>
      <FieldLegend variant="label" className="flex w-full items-center justify-between">
        구분{no}
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" aria-label={`구분${no} 삭제`} {...first(index, 'field-segment-delete')}>
          <Trash2Icon />
        </Button>
      </FieldLegend>
      <FieldGroup>
        <Field data-invalid={errors.age ? true : undefined} {...first(index, 'field-segment-age')}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-age`}>
            나이 <RequiredMark />
          </FieldLabel>
          <Input
            id={`${id}-age`}
            defaultValue={segment.age}
            placeholder={AGE_PLACEHOLDERS[index]}
            aria-invalid={errors.age ? true : undefined}
          />
          {errors.age && <FieldError>{errors.age}</FieldError>}
        </Field>
        <Field
          data-invalid={errors.limit ? true : undefined}
          data-disabled={segment.unlimited || undefined}
          {...first(index, 'field-segment-limit')}
        >
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-limit`}>월 결제 한도 {!segment.unlimited && <RequiredMark />}</FieldLabel>
          <InputGroup className="max-w-xs">
            <InputGroupInput
              id={`${id}-limit`}
              defaultValue={segment.limit}
              inputMode="numeric"
              disabled={segment.unlimited}
              aria-invalid={errors.limit ? true : undefined}
            />
            <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">円</InputGroupAddon>
          </InputGroup>
          {errors.limit && <FieldError>{errors.limit}</FieldError>}
        </Field>
        <Field orientation="horizontal" {...first(index, 'field-segment-unlimited')}>
          <Checkbox id={`${id}-unlimited`} defaultChecked={segment.unlimited} />
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-unlimited`} className="font-normal">
            제한 없음
          </FieldLabel>
        </Field>
        <Field orientation="horizontal" {...first(index, 'field-segment-guide')}>
          <FieldContent>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-guide`}>구간 안내 사용</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription>구분 선택 시 표시할 안내·확인 팝업을 설정합니다.</FieldDescription>
          </FieldContent>
          <Switch id={`${id}-guide`} defaultChecked={segment.guide.use} />
        </Field>
        {segment.guide.use && (
          <>
            <Field data-invalid={errors.guideTitle ? true : undefined} {...first(index, 'field-segment-guide-title')}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-guide-title`}>
                구간 안내 제목 <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${id}-guide-title`}
                defaultValue={segment.guide.title}
                aria-invalid={errors.guideTitle ? true : undefined}
              />
              {errors.guideTitle && <FieldError>{errors.guideTitle}</FieldError>}
            </Field>
            <Field data-invalid={errors.guideText ? true : undefined} {...first(index, 'field-segment-guide-text')}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-guide-text`}>
                구간 안내 문구 <RequiredMark />
              </FieldLabel>
              <Textarea
                id={`${id}-guide-text`}
                defaultValue={segment.guide.text}
                aria-invalid={errors.guideText ? true : undefined}
              />
              {errors.guideText && <FieldError>{errors.guideText}</FieldError>}
            </Field>
            <ReadonlyField label="이번 달 구매 가능 금액" specId={index === 0 ? 'field-segment-available' : undefined}>
              {availableAmount(segment)}
            </ReadonlyField>
          </>
        )}
      </FieldGroup>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}

/**
 * 화면 관리 > 연령 설정 수정(SC 6.3). 사용이면 왼쪽 입력, 오른쪽 미리보기(SC 6.4) 2열이고,
 * 미사용이면 사용 여부만 있는 입력 카드 하나다.
 */
function AgeSettingEdit({
  input,
  errors = {},
  initialView,
}: {
  input: AgeInput;
  errors?: AgeErrors;
  /** 미리보기 보기 전환의 처음 값. 'all' 또는 'segment-{n}'. */
  initialView?: string;
}) {
  const form = (
    <Card>
      <CardContent>
        <FieldGroup>
          <UsageField id="age-use" legend="사용 여부" defaultUse={input.use} specId="field-age-use" />
          {input.use && (
            <>
              <ChoiceField
                id="age-timing"
                legend="연령 확인 표시 시점"
                value={input.timing}
                options={TIMING_OPTIONS}
                specId="field-age-timing"
              />
              <ChoiceField
                id="age-type"
                legend="타입"
                value={input.type}
                options={TYPE_OPTIONS}
                specId="field-age-type"
              />
              <Field data-invalid={errors.title ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-age-title">
                <FieldLabel htmlFor="age-title">
                  제목 <RequiredMark />
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input id="age-title" defaultValue={input.title} aria-invalid={errors.title ? true : undefined} />
                {errors.title && <FieldError>{errors.title}</FieldError>}
              </Field>
              <NoticeField
                id="age-top"
                legend="상단 안내 문구"
                description="구분별 결제 한도 상단에 표시할 안내 문구입니다."
                notice={input.topNotice}
                specId="field-age-top"
              />
              <FieldSet>
                <FieldLegend variant="label">
                  구분별 결제 한도 <RequiredMark />
                </FieldLegend>
                {input.segments.map((segment, index) => (
                  <Fragment key={index}>
                    {index > 0 && <FieldSeparator />}
                    <SegmentFields segment={segment} index={index} errors={errors.segments?.[index]} />
                  </Fragment>
                ))}
                <div>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={input.segments.length >= MAX_SEGMENTS}
                    data-spec-id="field-segment-add"
                  >
                    <PlusIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                    구분 추가
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </FieldSet>
              <NoticeField
                id="age-bottom"
                legend="하단 안내 문구"
                description="구분별 결제 한도 하단에 표시할 안내 문구입니다."
                notice={input.bottomNotice}
                specId="field-age-bottom"
              />
            </>
          )}
        </FieldGroup>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
        <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
          취소
        </Button>
        <Button data-spec-id="page-save">저장</Button>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="연령 설정">
      <PageHeader back title="연령 설정 수정" />
      {input.use ? (
        <div className="grid items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,26rem)]">
          {form}
          <AgePreview input={input} initialView={initialView} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        form
      )}
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '화면 관리/3. 연령 설정/수정',
  component: AgeSettingEdit,
} satisfies Meta<typeof AgeSettingEdit>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

const SELECT_INPUT = toAgeInput(AGE_SELECT);

// ── 명세 ──

const BACK = pageBackSpec('연령 설정');

const USE: SpecAnnotation = {
  id: 'field-age-use',
  label: '사용 여부',
  state:
    '사용·미사용 중 하나를 고른다. 필수, 기본값 미사용(SC 6.3, SC 3.1). 사용이면 아래 하위 항목과 오른쪽 미리보기를 함께 보여 준다(SC 6.3, SC 6.4).',
  interaction: '가정: 미사용을 고르면 하위 항목과 미리보기를 감추고 사용 여부만 남긴다(미사용 스토리).',
};

const USE_CLEAR: SpecAnnotation = {
  id: 'field-age-use',
  label: '미사용 저장',
  state:
    '미사용으로 저장하면 타입·표시 시점, 제목, 상단·하단 안내 문구, 연령 구분(월 결제 한도·구간 안내 포함)을 모두 지우고, 상단·하단 안내 문구는 미사용이 된다. 다시 사용으로 바꿔도 이전 값은 복원하지 않는다(SC 6.5).',
};

const TIMING: SpecAnnotation = {
  id: 'field-age-timing',
  label: '연령 확인 표시 시점',
  state:
    '로그인 후 1회·구매 시마다 중 하나. 필수, 기본값 로그인 후 1회. 선택지마다 설명을 함께 보여 준다(SC 6.3). 로그인 후 1회는 로그인 후 처음 연령 확인을 마치면 다음 로그인 전까지 다시 확인하지 않고(로그인 세션 단위로 기억), 구매 시마다는 구매할 때마다 확인한다(SC 3.1, SC 6.9).',
};

const TIMING_MISSING: SpecAnnotation = {

};

const TYPE: SpecAnnotation = {
  id: 'field-age-type',

function NoticeValue({ notice }: { notice: AgeNotice }) {
  return notice.use ? <span className="whitespace-pre-line">{notice.text}</span> : <>미사용</>;
}

/** 화면 관리 > 연령 설정 조회(SC 6.2). 미사용이면 사용 여부와 [수정]만, 사용이면 SC 6.2가 열거한 항목만 보여 준다. */
function AgeSettingView({ setting }: { setting: AgeSetting }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="연령 설정">
      <PageHeader title="연령 설정" actions={<Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>} />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="사용 여부" specId="view-age-use">
              {setting.use ? '사용' : '미사용'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            {setting.use && (
              <>
                <ReadonlyField label="연령 확인 표시 시점" specId="view-age-timing">
                  {setting.timing}
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="타입" specId="view-age-type">
                  {setting.type}
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="제목" specId="view-age-title">
                  {setting.title}
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="상단 안내 문구" specId="view-age-top">
                  <NoticeValue notice={setting.topNotice} />
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="구분별 결제 한도" specId="view-age-segments">
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>구분</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>나이</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>월 결제 한도</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {setting.segments.map((segment, index) => (
                        <TableRow key={index}>
                          <TableCell>구분{index + 1}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{segment.age}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            {segment.unlimited || segment.monthlyLimit === null

                <ReadonlyField label="하단 안내 문구" specId="view-age-bottom">
                  <NoticeValue notice={setting.bottomNotice} />
                </ReadonlyField>
              </>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/**

 * spec/screen/prd-screen.md @ e43175fbfc16
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3

import { Fragment } from 'react';

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Field,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSeparator,
  FieldSet,
} from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';

import { ConsoleShell } from '../../shared/console-shell';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField, RequiredMark } from '../../shared/page';
import { pageBackSpec, pageCancelSpec, pageEditSpec, pageSaveSpec, publishTimingSpec } from '../shared/menu-spec';
import { BADGES_INVALID, BADGES_UNUSED, BADGES_USED, type BadgeSetting, type BadgeStore } from '../shared/mock';
import { first } from '../shared/spec-id';
import { UsageField } from '../shared/usage-field';

/** [저장]을 누른 직후의 URL 오류(SC 9.4). 스토어별 PC·Mobile. */
type BadgeErrors = Partial<Record<BadgeStore, { pc?: string; mobile?: string }>>;

/** 화면 관리 > 스토어 배지 조회(SC 9.1). 사용이면 세 스토어를 모두 보여 주고, 미선택 스토어는 URL 없이 보여 준다. */
function BadgeView({ setting }: { setting: BadgeSetting }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="스토어 배지">
      <PageHeader title="스토어 배지" actions={<Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>} />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="사용여부" specId="view-badge-use">
              {setting.use ? '사용' : '미사용'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            {setting.use && (
              <ReadonlyField label="스토어" specId="view-badge-stores">
                <Table>
                  <TableHeader>
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead>스토어</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>선택</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>PC</TableHead>
                      <TableHead>Mobile</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {setting.stores.map((store) => (
                      <TableRow key={store.store}>
                        <TableCell>{store.store}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{store.selected ? '선택' : '미선택'}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{store.selected ? store.pcUrl : '-'}</TableCell>
                        <TableCell>{store.selected ? store.mobileUrl : '-'}</TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    ))}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </ReadonlyField>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 화면 관리 > 스토어 배지 수정(SC 9.2). 사용일 때만 스토어별 항목을 입력받는다. */
function BadgeEdit({ setting, errors = {} }: { setting: BadgeSetting; errors?: BadgeErrors }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="스토어 배지">
      <PageHeader back title="스토어 배지 수정" />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <UsageField id="badge-use" legend="사용여부" defaultUse={setting.use} specId="field-badge-use" />
            {setting.use && (
              <FieldSet>
                <FieldLegend variant="label">
                  스토어 <RequiredMark />
                </FieldLegend>
                {setting.stores.map((store, index) => {
                  const id = `badge-store-${index + 1}`;
                  const error = errors[store.store] ?? {};
                  return (
                    <Fragment key={store.store}>
                      {index > 0 && <FieldSeparator />}
                      <FieldSet {...first(index, 'field-badge-store')}>
                        <Field orientation="horizontal">
                          <Checkbox id={id} defaultChecked={store.selected} />
                          <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{store.store}</FieldLabel>
                        </Field>
                        <FieldGroup className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                          <Field
                            data-invalid={error.pc ? true : undefined}
                            data-disabled={!store.selected || undefined}
                            {...first(index, 'field-badge-pc')}
                          >
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-pc`}>PC {store.selected && <RequiredMark />}</FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                              id={`${id}-pc`}
                              placeholder="Download URL"
                              defaultValue={store.pcUrl}
                              disabled={!store.selected}
                              aria-invalid={error.pc ? true : undefined}
                            />
                            {error.pc && <FieldError>{error.pc}</FieldError>}
                          </Field>
                          <Field
                            data-invalid={error.mobile ? true : undefined}
                            data-disabled={!store.selected || undefined}
                            {...first(index, 'field-badge-mobile')}
                          >
                            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-mobile`}>
                              Mobile {store.selected && <RequiredMark />}
                            </FieldLabel>
                            <Input
                              id={`${id}-mobile`}
                              placeholder="Download URL"
                              defaultValue={store.mobileUrl}
                              disabled={!store.selected}
                              aria-invalid={error.mobile ? true : undefined}
                            />
                            {error.mobile && <FieldError>{error.mobile}</FieldError>}
                          </Field>
                        </FieldGroup>
                      </FieldSet>
                    </Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </FieldSet>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button data-spec-id="page-save">저장</Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 조회·수정을 한 title에 두므로 스토리마다 화면을 고른다. */
function BadgeScreen({
  mode,
  setting,
  errors,
}: {
  mode: 'view' | 'edit';
  setting: BadgeSetting;
  errors?: BadgeErrors;
}) {
  return mode === 'view' ? <BadgeView setting={setting} /> : <BadgeEdit setting={setting} errors={errors} />;
}

/**

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { PlusIcon, Trash2Icon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSet,
} from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle } from '@/components/ui/item';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';

import { ConsoleShell } from '../../shared/console-shell';
import { ImagePlaceholder } from '../../shared/image-placeholder';
import { ImageUploadField } from '../../shared/image-upload-field';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField, RequiredMark } from '../../shared/page';
import { ColorInput, ColorValue } from '../shared/color-value';
import { pageBackSpec, pageCancelSpec, pageEditSpec, pageSaveSpec, publishTimingSpec } from '../shared/menu-spec';
import { FOOTER_INVALID, FOOTER_UNUSED, FOOTER_USED, type FooterSetting } from '../shared/mock';
import { first } from '../shared/spec-id';
import { UsageField } from '../shared/usage-field';

/** [저장]을 누른 직후의 필드 오류(SC 10.4). logoUrls·terms의 키는 입력 순서(0부터). */
type FooterErrors = {
  logoUrls?: Record<number, string>;
  terms?: Record<number, { label?: string; url?: string }>;
  copyright?: string;
};

const MAX_LOGOS = 2;
const MAX_TERMS = 7;

/** 회사 로고 권장 크기 200×40px(SC 2.2). */
const LOGO_RATIO = 200 / 40;

/** 회사 로고 업로드 안내(SC 10.2). */
const LOGO_GUIDE = [
  '최대 2개의 파일을 업로드 할 수 있습니다.',
  '5MB 이하, 200x40px 이하 이미지를 권장합니다.',
  '지원 형식: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP',
];

/** 화면 관리 > 푸터 조회(SC 10.1). 미사용이면 사용 여부만 보여 준다. */
function FooterView({ setting }: { setting: FooterSetting }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="푸터">
      <PageHeader title="푸터" actions={<Button data-spec-id="page-edit">수정</Button>} />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="사용 여부" specId="view-footer-use">
              {setting.use ? '사용' : '미사용'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            {setting.use && (
              <>
                <ReadonlyField label="푸터 색상" specId="view-footer-colors">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                      배경 색상 <ColorValue hex={setting.background} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                      키 색상 <ColorValue hex={setting.key} />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="회사 로고" specId="view-footer-logos">
                  {setting.logos.length === 0 ? (
                    '등록된 로고가 없습니다.'
                  ) : (
                    <ItemGroup>
                      {setting.logos.map((logo, index) => (
                        <Item key={index} variant="outline" size="sm">
                          <ItemMedia className="w-48">
                            <ImagePlaceholder caption={logo.caption} ratio={LOGO_RATIO} className="w-full" />
                          </ItemMedia>
                          <ItemContent>
                            <ItemTitle>이동 URL</ItemTitle>
                            <ItemDescription>{logo.url || '-'}</ItemDescription>
                          </ItemContent>
                        </Item>
                      ))}
                    </ItemGroup>
                  )}
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="약관" specId="view-footer-terms">
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>약관 항목</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>약관 URL</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {setting.terms.map((term, index) => (
                        <TableRow key={index}>
                          <TableCell>{term.label}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{term.url}</TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </ReadonlyField>
                <ReadonlyField label="Copyright" specId="view-footer-copyright">
                  {setting.copyright}
                </ReadonlyField>
              </>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 화면 관리 > 푸터 수정(SC 10.2). 사용일 때만 나머지 항목을 입력받는다. */
function FooterEdit({ setting, errors = {} }: { setting: FooterSetting; errors?: FooterErrors }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="화면 관리" sub="푸터">
      <PageHeader back title="푸터 수정" />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <UsageField id="footer-use" legend="사용 여부" defaultUse={setting.use} specId="field-footer-use" />
            {setting.use && (
              <>
                <FieldSet>
                  <FieldLegend variant="label">푸터 색상</FieldLegend>
                  <Field className="max-w-xs" data-spec-id="field-footer-bg">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="footer-bg">
                      배경 색상 <RequiredMark />
                    </FieldLabel>
                    <ColorInput id="footer-bg" value={setting.background} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field className="max-w-xs" data-spec-id="field-footer-key">
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor="footer-key">
                      키 색상 <RequiredMark />
                    </FieldLabel>
                    <ColorInput id="footer-key" value={setting.key} />
                  </Field>
                </FieldSet>
                <ImageUploadField
                  idPrefix="footer-logo"
                  label="회사 로고"
                  required
                  guide={LOGO_GUIDE}
                  images={setting.logos}
                  max={MAX_LOGOS}
                  ratio={LOGO_RATIO}
                  reorderable
                  itemExtra={(index) => {
                    const error = errors.logoUrls?.[index];
                    return (
                      <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined} {...first(index, 'field-footer-logo-url')}>
                        <FieldLabel htmlFor={`footer-logo-url-${index + 1}`}>이동 URL</FieldLabel>
                        <Input
                          id={`footer-logo-url-${index + 1}`}
                          placeholder="이동 URL"
                          defaultValue={setting.logos[index]?.url}
                          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
                        />
                        {error && <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>}
                        <FieldDescription>이미지 클릭 시 이동 URL로 오픈됩니다.</FieldDescription>
                      </Field>
                    );
                  }}
                />
                <FieldSet>
                  <FieldLegend variant="label">약관</FieldLegend>
                  {setting.terms.map((term, index) => {
                    const no = index + 1;
                    const error = errors.terms?.[index] ?? {};
                    return (
                      <div key={index} className="flex items-start gap-2" {...first(index, 'field-footer-term')}>
                        <Field data-invalid={error.label ? true : undefined} className="max-w-56">
                          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`footer-term-${no}-label`} className="sr-only">
                            약관 {no} 약관명
                          </FieldLabel>
                          <Input
                            id={`footer-term-${no}-label`}
                            placeholder="약관명"
                            defaultValue={term.label}
                            aria-invalid={error.label ? true : undefined}
                          />
                          {error.label && <FieldError>{error.label}</FieldError>}
                        </Field>
                        <Field data-invalid={error.url ? true : undefined}>
                          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`footer-term-${no}-url`} className="sr-only">
                            약관 {no} 약관 URL
                          </FieldLabel>
                          <Input
                            id={`footer-term-${no}-url`}
                            placeholder="약관 URL"
                            defaultValue={term.url}
                            aria-invalid={error.url ? true : undefined}
                          />
                          {error.url && <FieldError>{error.url}</FieldError>}
                        </Field>
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={`약관 ${no} 삭제`}>
                          <Trash2Icon />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                  <div>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      disabled={setting.terms.length >= MAX_TERMS}
                      data-spec-id="field-footer-term-add"
                    >
                      <PlusIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                      약관 추가
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </FieldSet>
                <Field data-invalid={errors.copyright ? true : undefined} data-spec-id="field-footer-copyright">
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor="footer-copyright">
                    Copyright <RequiredMark />
                  </FieldLabel>
                  <Input
                    id="footer-copyright"
                    placeholder="ⓒ 2025 Company Name"
                    defaultValue={setting.copyright}
                    aria-invalid={errors.copyright ? true : undefined}
                  />
                  {errors.copyright && <FieldError>{errors.copyright}</FieldError>}
                </Field>
              </>
            )}
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-cancel">
            취소
          </Button>
          <Button data-spec-id="page-save">저장</Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

/** 조회·수정을 한 title에 두므로 스토리마다 화면을 고른다. */
function FooterScreen({
  mode,
  setting,
  errors,
}: {
  mode: 'view' | 'edit';
  setting: FooterSetting;
  errors?: FooterErrors;
}) {
  return mode === 'view' ? <FooterView setting={setting} /> : <FooterEdit setting={setting} errors={errors} />;
}

/**

 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';

import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { StoreHomeBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-home';
import { STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN, STORE_USER } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';

/**
 * 로그아웃(SF 12). 배경은 로그인한 홈. menuOpen이면 사용자 메뉴에서 연 내 정보 메뉴,
 * confirm이면 내 정보 메뉴의 [로그아웃]을 고른 뒤의 확인 대화상자.
 */
function LogoutScreen({ menuOpen = false, confirm = false }: { menuOpen?: boolean; confirm?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <StoreShell user={STORE_USER} userMenuOpen={menuOpen}>
      <StoreHomeBody categories={STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN} />
      {confirm && <NoticeDialog title="로그아웃" message="로그아웃 하시겠습니까?" cancelLabel="취소" />}
    </StoreShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '스토어프론트/7. 로그아웃',
  component: LogoutScreen,
} satisfies Meta<typeof LogoutScreen>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

/**

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardFooter } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { FieldGroup } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { ImmediateApplyNotice, OPS_NOTICE_SPEC } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/immediate-apply-notice';
import { formatMaintenancePeriod } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/maintenance-display';
import { MAINTENANCE_HISTORY, type Maintenance } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/mock';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { formatDateTimeWithWeekday, formatDuration } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { PageHeader, ReadonlyField } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';
import { RichContent } from '@/wireframes/shared/rich-content';

const durationOf = (record: Maintenance) => formatDuration(record.endAt.getTime() - record.startAt.getTime());

/** 운영 > 점검 > 이력 > 점검 이력 상세 정보. */
function MaintenanceHistoryDetail({ record }: { record: Maintenance }) {
  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="운영" sub="점검" third="이력">
      <PageHeader back title="점검 이력 상세 정보" />
      <ImmediateApplyNotice />
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 기간" specId="view-period">
              {formatMaintenancePeriod(record)}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="소요 시간" specId="view-duration">
              {durationOf(record)}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 방식" specId="view-method">
              {record.immediate ? '즉시' : '예약'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 종료 예정 시각 표시" specId="view-show-end">
              {record.showEndTime ? 'Y' : 'N'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="담당자" specId="view-manager">
              {record.manager ?? '-'}
            </ReadonlyField>
            <ReadonlyField label="점검 화면" specId="view-screen">
              {record.screen.type === 'default' ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                  <span>기본 점검 화면</span>
                  <Card size="sm">
                    <CardContent>
                      <RichContent blocks={record.screen.blocks} />
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                  <span>외부 점검 화면 (URL)</span>
                  <span className="break-all">{record.screen.url}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </ReadonlyField>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="page-list">
            목록
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" data-spec-id="detail-preview">
            점검 미리보기
          </Button>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

}

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/operations/prd-operations.md @ 5f887ffe652e
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { HistoryIcon, SearchIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { Field, FieldTitle } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { ImmediateApplyNotice, OPS_NOTICE_SPEC } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/immediate-apply-notice';
import { formatMaintenancePeriod } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/maintenance-display';
import { MAINTENANCE_HISTORY, type Maintenance } from '@/wireframes/operations/shared/mock';
import { ConsoleShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/console-shell';
import { DateRangePicker } from '@/wireframes/shared/date-range-picker';
import { MOCK_NOW } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { ListPagination } from '@/wireframes/shared/list-pagination';
import { PageHeader } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';

/** 한 페이지 20건(OP 7.1). */
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/** UTC+9 기준 그 날짜의 00:00. */
const day = (date: string) => new Date(`${date}T00:00:00+09:00`);

/** 종료 일시가 조회 기간(시작일 00:00 ~ 종료일 24:00) 안에 드는 이력(OP 7.1). */
function inPeriod(record: Maintenance, from: Date, to: Date) {
  return record.endAt >= from && record.endAt.getTime() < to.getTime() + DAY_MS;
}

const RESULT_BADGE_VARIANTS = { 종료: 'secondary', '점검 해제': 'outline' } as const;

/** 운영 > 점검 > 이력. from·to는 검색 조건의 점검 기간이다. */
function MaintenanceHistoryList({ from, to }: { from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const records = MAINTENANCE_HISTORY.filter((record) => inPeriod(record, from, to));
  const rows = records.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <ConsoleShell menu="운영" sub="점검" third="이력">
      <PageHeader title="점검 이력" />
      <ImmediateApplyNotice />
      <Field orientation="horizontal" className="w-fit">
        <FieldTitle>점검 기간</FieldTitle>
        <DateRangePicker from={from} to={to} placeholder="날짜 선택" maxDate={MOCK_NOW} />
        <Button data-spec-id="search-submit">
          <SearchIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
          검색
        </Button>
      </Field>
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {records.length === 0 ? (
            <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <HistoryIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>조회된 결과가 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Table data-spec-id="list-table">
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>점검 기간</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>점검 사유</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>결과</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>담당자</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {rows.map((record, index) => (
                    <TableRow key={record.id} {...(index === 0 ? { 'data-spec-id': 'list-row' } : {})}>
                      <TableCell>{formatMaintenancePeriod(record)}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{record.reason}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {record.result && <Badge variant={RESULT_BADGE_VARIANTS[record.result]}>{record.result}</Badge>}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{record.manager ?? '-'}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
              <ListPagination page={1} totalPages={Math.ceil(records.length / PAGE_SIZE)} />
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </ConsoleShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '운영/1. 점검/이력',
  component: MaintenanceHistoryList,
} satisfies Meta<typeof MaintenanceHistoryList>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

/** 검색 영역 명세. current는 이 스토리의 조회 기간 설명이다. */
function searchSpec(current: string): SpecAnnotation[] {
  return [
    {
      id: 'search-period',
      label: '점검 기간',
      state: `검색 조건은 점검 기간(날짜 범위, 시작일~종료일) 하나다. 기본값은 오늘-29일 ~ 오늘(운영자 기기의 날짜 기준)이다. 종료 일시가 기간 안에 드는 점검을 조회한다(OP 7.1). ${current}`,
      interaction: '누르면 두 달 달력이 열리고 시작일과 종료일을 고른다.',
    },
    {
      id: 'search-period',
      label: '조회 기간 범위',
      state:
        '최대 30일(OP 7.1). 30일로 할지 1개월로 할지는 기획 확인 필요라 가정: 30일로 둔다. 가정: 시작일을 고르면 30일을 넘는 종료일과 오늘 이후 날짜는 고를 수 없다. 가정: 기간을 고르기 전 표시 문구는 "날짜 선택".',
    },
    {
      id: 'search-submit',
      label: '[검색]',
      interaction:
        '고른 기간으로 다시 조회하고 첫 페이지부터 보여 준다(OP 7.1). 가정: 기간을 고르기만 해서는 조회하지 않고 [검색]을 눌러야 조회한다.',
    },
  ];
}

/**

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';
import { CircleCheckIcon, CircleXIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { STORE_USER } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';

import { PAYMENT_RESULTS, type PaymentResultKind } from '../shared/mock';

/**
 * 모바일·태블릿 결제 결과 화면(SF 7.2). Payment 결제를 마치고 돌아오면 보여 준다.
 * 제목·본문은 SF 3.2 결과별 문구(가정). 성공·대기는 [상점으로 돌아가기]·[서비스로 이동], 실패·취소는 [확인].
 */
function PaymentResultScreen({ result }: { result: PaymentResultKind }) {
  const { title, message, treatedAsSuccess } = PAYMENT_RESULTS[result];

  return (
    <StoreShell user={STORE_USER}>
      <Empty data-spec-id="result-screen">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">{treatedAsSuccess ? <CircleCheckIcon /> : <CircleXIcon />}</EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{title}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>{message}</EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyContent>
          {treatedAsSuccess ? (
            <>
              <Button className="w-full" data-spec-id="result-back">
                상점으로 돌아가기
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="w-full" data-spec-id="result-service">
                서비스로 이동
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <Button className="w-full" data-spec-id="result-ok">
              확인
            </Button>
          )}
        </EmptyContent>
      </Empty>
    </StoreShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '스토어프론트/4. 구매·결제/결제 결과',

} satisfies Meta<typeof PaymentResultScreen>;

/**

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import {
  PREVIEW_CATEGORIES,
  PREVIEW_DETAIL_SAMPLES,
  PREVIEW_EMPTY_LAYOUT,
  PREVIEW_GUEST_ERRORS,
  PREVIEW_IDPS,
  PREVIEW_IDPS_WITHOUT_GUEST,
  type PreviewDevice,
} from '@/wireframes/preview/shared/mock';
import { PreviewFrame } from '@/wireframes/preview/shared/preview-frame';
import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { StoreHomeBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-home';
import { StoreLoginBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-login';
import { STORE_NAME } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreProductDetailBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-product';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';

/** 홈에서 한정 상품 횟수(PV 7.4)를 명세할 상품: 스타터 패키지(누적 1회) */
const ANNOTATED_PRODUCT_ID = 'P-1002';

/**
 * 미리보기 사이트(PV 7). 도구 막대 아래 기기 폭 영역에 작업본 스토어 화면을 그린다.
 * - page: 홈 / 상품 상세(한정 상품) / 판매 종료 상품 / 로그인
 * - emptyLayout: 작업본 레이아웃 없음(로고·배너·스토어 배지·푸터 없음)
 * - guestError: 로그인 화면으로 돌아와 띄운 미리보기 전용 Guest 로그인 실패 알림
 */
function PreviewSite({
  device = 'Desktop',
  page,
  emptyLayout = false,
  guestError,
}: {
  device?: PreviewDevice;
  page: 'home' | 'detail' | 'ended' | 'login';
  emptyLayout?: boolean;
  guestError?: keyof typeof PREVIEW_GUEST_ERRORS;
}) {
  const layout = emptyLayout ? PREVIEW_EMPTY_LAYOUT : undefined;
  // 작업본에서 Guest IdP를 지운 뒤 돌아온 로그인 화면에는 게스트 버튼이 없다(CR 6.1)
  const idps = guestError === 'notRegistered' ? PREVIEW_IDPS_WITHOUT_GUEST : PREVIEW_IDPS;

  return (
    <PreviewFrame device={device}>
      <StoreShell chrome={page === 'login' ? 'nav-only' : 'full'} logo={layout?.logo} footer={layout?.footer}>
        {page === 'home' && (
          <StoreHomeBody
            categories={PREVIEW_CATEGORIES}
            banners={layout?.banners}
            badges={layout?.badges}
            annotateProductId={ANNOTATED_PRODUCT_ID}
          />
        )}
        {page === 'detail' && <StoreProductDetailBody {...PREVIEW_DETAIL_SAMPLES.limited} />}
        {page === 'ended' && <StoreProductDetailBody {...PREVIEW_DETAIL_SAMPLES.ended} ended />}
        {page === 'login' && <StoreLoginBody idps={idps} />}
        {guestError && <NoticeDialog title="로그인 실패" message={PREVIEW_GUEST_ERRORS[guestError]} />}
      </StoreShell>
    </PreviewFrame>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '미리보기/1. 미리보기 사이트',
  component: PreviewSite,
} satisfies Meta<typeof PreviewSite>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/storefront/prd-storefront.md @ a770a3c9a6c4
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';
import { ReceiptTextIcon, SearchIcon } from 'lucide-react';

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldTitle } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle } from '@/components/ui/item';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { DateRangePicker } from '@/wireframes/shared/date-range-picker';
import { formatDate, formatDateTime, formatPrice, MOCK_NOW } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { ImagePlaceholder } from '@/wireframes/shared/image-placeholder';
import { ListPagination } from '@/wireframes/shared/list-pagination';
import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { STORE_ERROR_MESSAGE } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';

import { PURCHASE_HISTORY, type PurchaseHistory } from '../shared/mock';
import { MYPAGE_TABS_ANNOTATIONS, MypageArea } from './area';

type SearchType = '상품명' | '구매번호';

const SEARCH_TYPES: { label: SearchType; value: SearchType }[] = [
  { label: '상품명', value: '상품명' },
  { label: '구매번호', value: '구매번호' },
];

const KEYWORD_PLACEHOLDERS: Record<SearchType, string> = {
  상품명: '상품명을 입력하세요.',
  구매번호: '구매번호를 입력하세요.',
};

/** 한 페이지에 보여 주는 구매번호 수(SF 11.3) */
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/** 오늘(MOCK_NOW)에서 days일 전 */
const daysAgo = (days: number) => new Date(MOCK_NOW.getTime() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

/**
 * 구매 이력(SF 11.3). 검색 조건 → 구매번호 단위 카드 목록 → 페이지네이션.
 * failed면 목록 영역을 비우고 오류 알림을 띄운다.
 */
function PurchaseHistoryScreen({
  searchType = '상품명',
  keyword = '',
  from,
  records,
  failed = false,
}: {
  searchType?: SearchType;
  keyword?: string;
  from: Date;
  records: PurchaseHistory[];
  failed?: boolean;
}) {
  const receivedIndex = records.findIndex((record) => record.receivedAt !== undefined);

  return (
    <MypageArea tab="구매 이력">
      <Card>
        <CardContent>
          <FieldGroup className="@3xl:grid @3xl:grid-cols-[10rem_minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto] @3xl:items-end">
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="history-search-type">검색 조건</FieldLabel>
              <Select items={SEARCH_TYPES} defaultValue={searchType}>
                <SelectTrigger id="history-search-type" data-spec-id="search-type">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectGroup>
                    {SEARCH_TYPES.map((item) => (
                      <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                        {item.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectGroup>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="history-search-keyword">검색어</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id="history-search-keyword"
                data-spec-id="search-keyword"
                placeholder={KEYWORD_PLACEHOLDERS[searchType]}
                defaultValue={keyword}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldTitle>구매일자</FieldTitle>
              <DateRangePicker from={from} to={MOCK_NOW} placeholder="날짜를 선택해주세요." maxDate={MOCK_NOW} />
            </Field>
            <Button data-spec-id="search-submit">
              <SearchIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
              검색
            </Button>
          </FieldGroup>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {!failed && records.length === 0 && (
        <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <ReceiptTextIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>구매 이력이 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
          </EmptyHeader>
        </Empty>
      )}

      {!failed && records.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {records.map((record, index) => (
              <PurchaseCard
                key={record.purchaseNo}
                record={record}
                annotate={index === 0}
                annotateReceived={index === receivedIndex}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
          <ListPagination page={1} totalPages={Math.ceil(records.length / PAGE_SIZE)} />
        </>
      )}

      {failed && <NoticeDialog title="오류" message={STORE_ERROR_MESSAGE} />}
    </MypageArea>
  );
}

/** 구매번호 하나의 구매 내역. 총합·환불 표시는 없다(SF 11.3) */
function PurchaseCard({
  record,
  annotate,
  annotateReceived,
}: {
  record: PurchaseHistory;
  annotate: boolean;
  annotateReceived: boolean;
}) {
  const spec = (id: string, on: boolean) => (on ? { 'data-spec-id': id } : {});

  return (
    <Card {...spec('history-card', annotate)}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>구매번호 {record.purchaseNo}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>구매일시 {formatDateTime(record.purchasedAt, 'second')}</CardDescription>
        {record.receivedAt !== undefined && (
          <CardAction>
            <Badge
              variant={record.receivedAt ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
              {...spec('history-received', annotateReceived)}
            >
              {record.receivedAt ? `수령일 ${formatDate(record.receivedAt)}` : '미수령'}
            </Badge>
          </CardAction>
        )}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ItemGroup>
          {record.items.map((item, index) => (
            <Item key={item.name} variant="muted" {...spec('history-item', annotate && index === 0)}>
              <ItemMedia className="w-16">
                <ImagePlaceholder caption={item.imageCaption} empty={!item.imageCaption} className="w-full" />
              </ItemMedia>
              <ItemContent>
                <ItemTitle>{item.name}</ItemTitle>
                <ItemDescription>수량 {item.quantity}개</ItemDescription>
              </ItemContent>
              <ItemContent>
                <ItemTitle>{formatPrice(item.quantity * item.unitPrice, item.currency)}</ItemTitle>
              </ItemContent>
            </Item>
          ))}
        </ItemGroup>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '스토어프론트/6. 마이페이지/구매 이력',
  component: PurchaseHistoryScreen,
} satisfies Meta<typeof PurchaseHistoryScreen>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/storefront/prd-storefront.md @ a770a3c9a6c4
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';

import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { StoreHomeBody } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-home';
import { STORE_CATEGORIES, STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN, STORE_USER } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';

import { PAYMENT_RESULTS, PURCHASE_ERRORS } from '../shared/mock';

/**
 * 구매를 시작한 화면(홈) 위에 띄운 구매 관련 알림(SF 7.1~7.3). PC 기준이며 Payment 결제창은 외부 화면이라 그리지 않는다.
 * - loggedIn: 비로그인이면 [로그인]과 구매 횟수 0 기준 홈, 로그인이면 사용자 메뉴와 본인 구매 횟수 기준 홈
 * - buyProductId: [구매하기]를 누른 상품. 이 상품 카드에 product-* spec id를 붙인다(생략하면 첫 상품)
 * - notice: 띄운 알림의 제목·본문
 */
function PurchaseScreen({
  loggedIn,
  buyProductId,
  notice,
}: {
  loggedIn: boolean;
  buyProductId?: string;
  notice: { title: string; message: string };
}) {
  return (
    <StoreShell user={loggedIn ? STORE_USER : null}>
      <StoreHomeBody
        categories={loggedIn ? STORE_CATEGORIES_LOGGED_IN : STORE_CATEGORIES}
        annotateProductId={buyProductId}
      />
      <NoticeDialog title={notice.title} message={notice.message} />
    </StoreShell>
  );
}

const meta = {
  title: '스토어프론트/4. 구매·결제/구매',
  component: PurchaseScreen,
} satisfies Meta<typeof PurchaseScreen>;

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;

/**
 * prd-sync
 * spec/storefront/prd-storefront.md @ a770a3c9a6c4
 * spec/common/prd-common.md @ fb3a35aa67e3
 */
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react-vite';
import type { SpecAnnotation } from 'storybook-addon-spec';
import {
  ArrowLeftIcon,
  CheckIcon,
  CloudOffIcon,
  ExternalLinkIcon,
  InfoIcon,
  PackageOpenIcon,
  RefreshCwIcon,
  SearchIcon,
  SearchXIcon,
  TriangleAlertIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Alert, AlertAction, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from '@/components/ui/empty';
import { Field, FieldError, FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/field';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput } from '@/components/ui/input-group';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group';

import { formatDateTime } from '@/wireframes/shared/format';
import { ImagePlaceholder } from '@/wireframes/shared/image-placeholder';
import { NoticeDialog } from '@/wireframes/shared/notice-dialog';
import { PageHeader } from '@/wireframes/shared/page';
import { STORE_USER, type StoreLimitType } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-mock';
import { StoreShell } from '@/wireframes/shared/store-shell';
import {
  QA_ITEMS,
  QA_SERVER_TIME,
  qaFilterOf,
  type QaFilter,
  type QaItem,
  type QaSettingState,
} from '@/wireframes/storefront/shared/mock';

const FILTERS: QaFilter[] = ['전체', '설정 중', '만료', '미설정'];

/** 데일리 코인 묶음: 기준값 1을 방금 [적용]해 "적용되었습니다."를 보이는 상품(목록 스토리) */
const JUST_APPLIED_ID = 'P-1006';

/** 검색 비교용: 전각·반각, 대소문자를 구분하지 않는다(SF 15.3) */
function normalize(text: string) {
  return text.normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase();
}

/** 구매 한도 주기 표기 `{유효} / {한도} 회({…})`(SF 15.3) */
const CYCLE_LABELS: Record<StoreLimitType, string> = {
  누적: '누적',
  일간: '매일',
  주간: '매주',
  월간: '매월',
  연간: '매년',
};

const STATE_BADGE_VARIANTS: Record<QaSettingState, 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline'> = {
  미설정: 'secondary',
  '적용 중': 'default',
  '만료(집계 기간 갱신)': 'outline',
  '만료(한도 변경을 포함한 재발행)': 'outline',
};

const CLEAR_ALL_MESSAGE =
  '로그인한 계정에서 설정한 모든 기준값이 해제됩니다. 목록에 표시되지 않은 상품의 설정도 함께 해제됩니다. 구매 횟수는 0이 되지 않으며, 실제 구매 이력에 따른 횟수로 돌아갑니다.';

/** 반복 행에서 첫 행에만 spec id를 붙인다 */
function specIf(on: boolean, id: string) {
  return on ? { 'data-spec-id': id } : {};
}

/**
 * QA 설정(SF 15). 상점 테마만 적용한 셸 안에 전용 머리 영역 → QA 설정 메뉴 → 구매 횟수 설정을 놓는다.
 * - state: 'ready' 목록 / 'load-error' 처음 조회 실패 / 'reload-error' 다시 불러오기 실패 / 'unavailable' 사용 여부 확인 실패
 * - items는 대상 상품 전체, search·filter로 표시할 행을 거른다
 * - appliedProductId는 방금 [적용]에 성공해 "적용되었습니다."를 보이는 상품
 * - inputError는 [적용]을 누른 뒤 한 상품의 기준값 오류, dialog는 목록 위에 연 확인·오류 알림
 */
function QaSettingsScreen({
  state = 'ready',
  items = QA_ITEMS,
  search = '',
  filter = '전체',
  appliedProductId,
  inputError,
  dialog,
}: {
  state?: 'ready' | 'load-error' | 'reload-error' | 'unavailable';
  items?: QaItem[];
  search?: string;
  filter?: QaFilter;
  appliedProductId?: string;
  inputError?: { productId: string; value: string; message: string };
  dialog?: 'clear-all' | 'apply-failed';
}) {
  const keyword = normalize(search.trim());
  const visible = items.filter(
    (item) => (filter === '전체' || qaFilterOf(item.state) === filter) && normalize(item.name).includes(keyword),
  );
  const countOf = (value: QaFilter) =>
    value === '전체' ? items.length : items.filter((item) => qaFilterOf(item.state) === value).length;

  return (
    <StoreShell chrome="none">
      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-6xl flex-1 flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-6 @3xl:px-8">
        {state === 'unavailable' ? (
          <Empty data-spec-id="qa-unavailable">
            <EmptyHeader>
              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                <CloudOffIcon />
              </EmptyMedia>
              <EmptyTitle>QA 설정을 불러오지 못했습니다.</EmptyTitle>
            </EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyContent>
              <Button variant="outline">다시 시도</Button>
            </EmptyContent>
          </Empty>
        ) : (
          <>
            <header data-spec-id="qa-header">
              <PageHeader
                title="QA 설정"
                badge={<Badge variant="secondary">SANDBOX 전용</Badge>}
                actions={
                  <>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">로그인 중: {STORE_USER.displayId}</span>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-spec-id="qa-back">
                      <ArrowLeftIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                      상점으로 돌아가기
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" data-spec-id="qa-logout">
                      로그아웃
                    </Button>
                  </>
                }
              />
            </header>

            <Tabs defaultValue="purchase-count">
              <TabsList data-spec-id="qa-menu" aria-label="QA 설정 메뉴">
                <TabsTrigger value="purchase-count">구매 횟수</TabsTrigger>
              </TabsList>
              <TabsContent value="purchase-count">
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle>구매 횟수 설정</CardTitle>
                    <CardAction>
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-spec-id="qa-clear-all">
                        모든 설정 해제
                      </Button>
                    </CardAction>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                    <Alert data-spec-id="qa-guide">
                      <InfoIcon />
                      <AlertDescription>안내 문구(기획 확인 필요)</AlertDescription>
                    </Alert>

                    {state === 'load-error' ? (
                      <Empty data-spec-id="qa-load-error">
                        <EmptyHeader>
                          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                            <CloudOffIcon />
                          </EmptyMedia>
                          <EmptyTitle>구매 횟수를 불러오지 못했습니다.</EmptyTitle>
                        </EmptyHeader>
                        <EmptyContent>
                          <Button variant="outline">다시 시도</Button>
                        </EmptyContent>
                      </Empty>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                            <InputGroup data-spec-id="qa-search" className="@3xl:w-64">
                              <InputGroupAddon>
                                <SearchIcon />
                              </InputGroupAddon>
                              <InputGroupInput
                                aria-label="상품명 검색"
                                placeholder="상품명 검색"
                                defaultValue={search}
                              />
                            </InputGroup>
                            <ToggleGroup
                              data-spec-id="qa-filter"
                              aria-label="상태 필터"
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"
                              defaultValue={[filter]}
                              className="flex-wrap"
                            >
                              {FILTERS.map((value) => (
                                <ToggleGroupItem key={value} value={value}>
                                  {value} ({countOf(value)})
                                </ToggleGroupItem>
                              ))}
                            </ToggleGroup>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
                            <span data-spec-id="qa-count">
                              전체 {items.length}개 중 {visible.length}개 표시
                            </span>
                            <span data-spec-id="qa-server-time" className="text-muted-foreground">
                              서버 시각 {formatDateTime(QA_SERVER_TIME)} (GMT+9)
                            </span>
                            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="ml-auto" data-spec-id="qa-refresh">
                              <RefreshCwIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                              최신 상태로 새로고침
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {state === 'reload-error' && (
                          <Alert variant="destructive" data-spec-id="qa-reload-error">
                            <TriangleAlertIcon />
                            <AlertTitle>최신 구매 횟수를 불러오지 못했습니다.</AlertTitle>
                            <AlertDescription>지금 표시된 내용은 이전에 불러온 정보입니다.</AlertDescription>
                            <AlertAction>
                              <Button variant="outline" size="xs">
                                다시 시도
                              </Button>
                            </AlertAction>
                          </Alert>
                        )}

                        {items.length === 0 ? (
                          <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
                            <EmptyHeader>
                              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                                <PackageOpenIcon />
                              </EmptyMedia>
                              <EmptyTitle>구매 횟수를 설정할 수 있는 상품이 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
                              <EmptyDescription>
                                현재 발행된 상점에 구매 횟수 제한 상품이 추가되면 여기에 표시됩니다.
                              </EmptyDescription>
                            </EmptyHeader>
                          </Empty>
                        ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
                          <Empty data-spec-id="list-empty">
                            <EmptyHeader>
                              <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                                <SearchXIcon />
                              </EmptyMedia>
                              <EmptyTitle>조건에 맞는 상품이 없습니다.</EmptyTitle>
                            </EmptyHeader>
                            <EmptyContent>
                              <Button variant="outline">조건 지우기</Button>
                            </EmptyContent>
                          </Empty>
                        ) : (
                          <Table data-spec-id="list-table">
                            <TableHeader>
                              <TableRow>
                                <TableHead>상품</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>유효 구매 횟수 / 구매 한도</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>설정 상태</TableHead>
                                <TableHead>기준값 설정</TableHead>
                              </TableRow>
                            </TableHeader>
                            <TableBody>
                              {visible.map((item, index) => (
                                <QaRow
                                  key={item.id}
                                  item={item}
                                  first={index === 0}
                                  applied={item.id === appliedProductId}
                                  error={inputError?.productId === item.id ? inputError : undefined}
                                />
                              ))}
                            </TableBody>
                          </Table>
                        )}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </TabsContent>
            </Tabs>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {dialog === 'clear-all' && (
        <NoticeDialog
          title="모든 설정을 해제하시겠습니까?"
          message={CLEAR_ALL_MESSAGE}
          cancelLabel="취소"
          confirmLabel="모두 해제"
        />
      )}
      {dialog === 'apply-failed' && (
        <NoticeDialog title="오류" message="변경하지 못했습니다. (오류 코드: SAMPLE-500)" />
      )}
    </StoreShell>
  );
}

/** 구매 횟수 목록의 한 행(SF 15.3, 15.4). first면 열마다 spec id를 붙이고, applied면 "적용되었습니다."를 보인다 */
function QaRow({
  item,
  first,
  applied,
  error,
}: {
  item: QaItem;
  first: boolean;
  applied: boolean;
  error?: { value: string; message: string };
}) {
  const reached = item.effectiveCount >= item.max;
  const over = item.effectiveCount > item.max;
  const expired = qaFilterOf(item.state) === '만료';
  const nextReset =
    item.limitType === '누적' ? '리셋 없음(누적)' : item.nextResetAt ? formatDateTime(item.nextResetAt) : '—';

  return (
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell {...specIf(first, 'qa-product')}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-20 shrink-0">
            <ImagePlaceholder empty={!item.imageCaption} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
            <span>{item.name}</span>
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              <Badge variant="outline">{item.saleStatus}</Badge>
              {!item.paymentInUse && <Badge variant="destructive">사용 중지</Badge>}
            </div>
            <Button
              variant="link"
              size="xs"
              render={<a href="#" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" />}
              nativeButton={false}
            >
              상점에서 확인
              <ExternalLinkIcon data-icon="inline-end" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </TableCell>

      <TableCell {...specIf(first, 'qa-usage')}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>
              {item.effectiveCount} / {item.max} 회({CYCLE_LABELS[item.limitType]})
            </span>
            {reached && <Badge variant={over ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'}>{over ? '한도 초과' : '한도 도달'}</Badge>}
          </div>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">실제 구매 횟수: {item.actualCount}</span>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">다음 리셋: {nextReset}</span>
        </div>
      </TableCell>

      <TableCell {...specIf(first, 'qa-state')}>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
          <Badge variant={STATE_BADGE_VARIANTS[item.state]}>{item.state}</Badge>
          <span>
            기준값: <span className={cn(expired && 'line-through')}>{item.baseValue ?? '—'}</span>
          </span>
          <span>적용 시각: {item.appliedAt ? formatDateTime(item.appliedAt) : '—'}</span>
          {expired && <span className="text-muted-foreground">이 기준값은 현재 계산에 적용되지 않습니다</span>}
        </div>
      </TableCell>

      <TableCell>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined} className="w-24" {...specIf(first, 'qa-base-input')}>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`qa-base-${item.id}`} className="sr-only">
                {item.name} 기준값
              </FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`qa-base-${item.id}`}
                inputMode="numeric"
                placeholder="0~1000"
                defaultValue={error?.value}
                aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
              />
            </Field>
            <Button size="sm" {...specIf(first, 'qa-apply')}>
              적용
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" {...specIf(first, 'qa-unset')}>
              설정 해제
            </Button>
          </div>
          {error && <FieldError>{error.message}</FieldError>}
          <div className="flex gap-1" {...specIf(first, 'qa-presets')}>
            <Button variant="outline" size="xs">
              0부터 다시 세기
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="xs">
              한도까지 1회 남음({item.max - 1})
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="xs">
              한도 도달({item.max})
            </Button>
          </div>
          {applied && (
            <Badge variant="secondary" data-spec-id="qa-applied">
              <CheckIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
              적용되었습니다.
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
      </TableCell>
    </TableRow>
  );
}
